title: Bhraanti an illusion [Hindi]
description: Manju, a meek and docile housewife, possessed by a vengeful spirit starts scaring her dominating mother in law, and seductively controls her husband. Chaos ensues in the small town when all young women follow suit, leading to an unlikely uprising.

title: An American in England: An Animated Short Film
description: An American man goes to England on his vacation, and guess what happens next? An epic, humorous, full of action packed adventure, tells the story of an American man who journeys through England, and fulfills his lifelong dream. A funny short animated film about the wonderful misadventures, that happens only once in a lifetime.

title: Dissection of an Olive
description: Livi (Kaelynn Hong) writes about Mikiah (Chris Clarke), who reveals Livi's story as he experiences his. The title character, like her yard-camping, singing-telegramming mother (Laura Fair-Schultz), struggles with intimacy, stability and how to grieve.

title: An Apology to Elephants
description: Narrated by Lily Tomlin, this documentary short traces mankind's long history with elephants and explores the many problems that arise when they are brought to live in captivity in zoos and circuses.

title: An Unprecedented Campaign
description: Made during the rapid industrialization and collectivization of Stalin's Five-Year Plan. Kaufman countered the poverty of the villages with the geometrical rhythm of mechanized factories; militarization is shown as the next step of the 'unprecedented campaign'. "The proletariat, having become master of one sixth of the globe, frees the rural working people from the kulak oppression...THE PROLETARIAT...engages the peasantry in a joint campaign for Socialism. This is what the film speaks about".

title: An Alien Son
description: 25 year-old Anna is married to Vadim, a successful businessman and owner of a construction firm. Vadim's first wife had died some years ago, and their fifteen year-old son, Yegor is now studying at a technical school in London. Vadim is twenty years older than Anna, and their age difference sometimes creates problems, as their relationship often seems more like that of a father and daughter. Anna is grateful to Vadim for all he does for her but is upset that he does not take her seriously, because Anna dreams one day of becoming a famous photographer. Their relationship is beset by more complications when Yegor arrives home from the UK to spend his vacation. The boy, believing that Anna has only married his father for his money, starts to make life hell for his stepmother. In despair, Anna makes a dreadful mistake that leads to a chain of fatal events ending in a horrendous car accident in which Vadim is killed and Yegor is seriously injured. The doctors' verdict is devastating - the boy has a severe spinal injury and will never be able to walk again. In a desperate attempt to make amends, Anna decides to try and set Yegor back on his feet at all costs. Physiotherapist Roman Gromov gives Anna his 'shoulder' as support. In doing so, he will also help Anna to better understand herself, discover her talents and learn the meaning of true love.

description: Scent of Revenge ⠀full

title: An Impossible Voyage
description: Using every known means of transportation, several savants from the Geographic Society undertake a journey through the Alps to the Sun which finishes under the sea.

title: An American Pickle
description: When a mishap lands a Jewish worker in a vat of pickle brine at the factory where he works, he mysteriously gets preserved for over a century. Waking up to a different world in modern-day Brooklyn, his only way to navigate his changed reality lies with his great-great-grandson.

title: An Intimate History
description: Through archival footage and testimonies, this documentary describes the daily lives of the French population and German soldiers during the Occupation, between 1940 and 1944.

title: An American Ghost Tail
description: Two teenage girls Janie Hell Water and Victoria Lively (Chloe Klitus / Preslee Tucker) find themselves trapped in the afterlife by the presence of an old Indian ritual. When their killer returns (Brandon Itz) for the undoing of a new resident Jacklyn Farb (Skye Todaro) the two teenage ghost must protect her to break free from their mysterious death, and return to their K9 mate (Ranger Welling) who awaits them in a more peaceful and final after life.

title: Anne with an E S3
description: The adventures of a young orphan girl living in late-19th-century Canada. Follow Anne as she learns to navigate her new life on Prince Edward Island in this new take on L.M. Montgomery's classic novels.

title: Dez Anos do Contrato ao Coração
description: Paulo, uma figura inalcançável e reservada, descobre que Clara, a garota por quem secretamente se apaixonou por anos, fica solteira. Na mesma noite, ele avança e propõe casamento. Clara nunca imaginou envolver-se com seu chefe numa relação clandestina. Acreditava que ambos cediam à pressão familiar, até descobrir que Paulo, a quem jamais ousara aspirar, a amava em segredo há dez anos e planejava tudo para se tornar seu marido.

title: Leve-me ao Hades, estou morrendo
description: A irmã de Dakota James é chantageada por um implacável dono de um clube de sexo. Dakota fica tão desesperada que acaba propondo um contrato de relacionamento a Jaxon Shaw, um bilionário misterioso que nunca toca em suas amantes. Exceto Dakota. Desde o primeiro toque, Jaxon começa a se apaixonar por ela. No entanto, o relacionamento secreto deles termina de forma brutal quando Dakota descobre que está morrendo e decide se afastar de Jaxon para protegê-lo. No entanto, ela acaba se envolvendo demais com o dono do clube e é salva por um homem mascarado conhecido como Hades, Jaxon disfarçado. O tempo está se esgotando para os amantes predestinados. Jaxon descobrirá o segredo mortal de Dakota a tempo de salvá-la? Ou as forças que conspiram contra eles destruirão seu amor para sempre?

title: Desculpe ao Meu Corpo Morto
description: Viviane Alves, uma socialite de Manhattan, é traída pelo irmão Edo Alves e acaba participando de um cruel reality show. Lá, é torturada por seu noivo Lucas Costa e a rival Sofia Branco, morrendo no processo. A morte de Viviane é inicialmente vista como atuação, mas a verdade vem à tona quando seu corpo é revelado. Lucas e Sofia são condenados; Edo se isola pela culpa, enquanto a família tenta honrar Viviane.

title: Arrependeu-se ao Saber A Verdade
description: Viviane Pereira, em gratidão a Marcos por ter salvado sua vida, aturou todo tipo de humilhação vinda do filho dele, Edson. No entanto, Edson se passou por presidente da empresa e incentivou a namorada a colocar um bilhete nela para humilhá-la. Viviane então descobriu que Marcos foi na verdade o verdadeiro assassino de sua mãe. Para piorar, Edson ainda tentou vender os segredos da empresa. No final, ela conseguiu se vingar de todos.

title: Ao oni ver. 2.0
description: Some Friends go into a mansion that is rumored to have monsters inside and what they find will change their lives forever...

title: Traída? Assista ao Seu Reinado
description: Cecília, conhecida como louca e feia no Império Fradore, é humilhada ao dar à luz um “filho bastardo”. No dia do casamento do ex-noivo, ela se joga da muralha com seu vestido de noiva... Mas abre os olhos com a alma de uma mestre de artes marciais do século 23. Agora, o jogo virou: quem ousar rir dela, pagará com sangue. E o filho ilegítimo? Nada menos que herdeiro do Imperador Celestial, dono de um poder que fará os Oito Reinos se curvarem.

title: Renascer ao Lado do Meu Tio
description: A Camila foi atropelada por um carro sem placa e ficou em estado vegetativo, perdendo o amoroso tio, José. Após reencarnar, a Camilai corre atrás do tio, finge ser boba para lidar com a maldita madrasta e a meia-irmã, e consegue se vingar. No final, ela fica feliz com o tio!

title: [Dublado]Regressuo, Do Desprezado ao Topo
description: Mateus desperta um sistema e obtém o lendário Dragão Primordial. Ele vence o vestibular, derrota Felipe, evolui suas feras com um ovo de dragão, domina os testes da academia e a Torre das Feras, tornando-se o melhor calouro.

title: Submissa ao Desejo Sombrio (Dublado)
description: Amélia, uma empregada de 20 anos, é demitida após entrar por acidente no quarto secreto de BDSM de seu chefe bilionário, Élton. Endividada e abandonada pelo namorado, que é secretamente sobrinho dele, ela aceita um contrato de casamento falso de 1 ano por 5 milhões para escapar de um casamento arranjado. Vivendo juntos, a atração cresce entre jogos psicológicos e sentimentos confusos. Quando Amélia é sequestrada, Élton a salva e a assume publicamente como sua esposa.

title: O Quarterback da Casa ao Lado
description: A sempre invisível Skylar Heron não começou o último ano muito bem. Primeiro, ela passa vergonha na frente de toda a escola ao tentar chamar para sair seu crush, Jamie Donner, seu melhor amigo de infância e vizinho. Depois, eles formam dupla para um trabalho escolar. E, para completar, ela é obrigada a morar com ele quando a casa dele pega fogo e ele se muda para o quarto dela! Mas agora, a ex-namorada louca de Jamie está disposta a infernizar a vida deles. A única coisa que pode salvar o ano dos dois é... transformar a esquisita da escola na garota mais popular do colégio!

title: Ao Sul do Meu Corpo
description: São Paulo, late 30's. Alberto is an intellectual and professor who announces to his friend and student Polidoro that he won a scholarship to study in Paris.

title: A Rainha que Renunciou ao Destino
description: Maeve, descendente de unicórnios, vive dividida entre dois mundos: o fantástico Reino de Mythos, governado por reis-bestas, e sua realidade moderna. Traída por seus irmãos Edric (Rei Wharth), Vulcan (Rei Wifin), Alphard (Rei Grifo) e pelo marido Silas, ela é forçada a um ritual para transplantar seu coração em sua irmã gêmea Cassandra — uma manipuladora mulher-cisne. Após sobreviver à provação e retornar ao seu mundo, Maeve reencontra Sandy, sua gêmea desaparecida que também escapou do reino das bestas. Juntas, buscam um desfecho, mas são arrastadas de volta por obsessão e rituais de sangue. No confronto final, Cassandra se revela como a própria Sandy e comete regicídio, tomando o poder no Reino de Mythos. Maeve empodera a irmã para se tornar rainha, libertando-se enfim e recuperando sua alma no mundo real.

title: AO Driver Stories

title: Do sertão ao beco da Lapa
Da Pobreza ao Poder: Herdeira
description: A filha do homem mais rico fugiu do próprio casamento para procurar seu namorado de longa data. Por acaso, encontrou uma colega de faculdade que a imitou, usando secretamente as joias da filha do homem rico e fingindo ser a herdeira. Quando a verdadeira herdeira estava sendo intimidada, encontrou seu namorado, que foi frio com ela e estava prestes a se casar com a impostora. No casamento do namorado com a impostora, a verdadeira herdeira revelou a identidade da impostora.

title: A Jornada de Rodrigo ao Topo
description: Na vida passada, Rodrigo Soares fez de tudo pela namorada: preparou materiais e até abandonou a segunda etapa do concurso público para que ela conquistasse a única vaga no gabinete do governo municipal. Ela passou em primeiro lugar, mas, ao subir na vida, trocou-o por um pretendente mais influente. Quando Rodrigo Soares  tentou reconciliar, foi humilhado. Agora, renascido, ele rompeu sem hesitar, focou no concurso, passou em primeiro lugar e está recuperando tudo que é seu por direito.

title: Do Lar ao Poder
description: Isabela Almeida, a verdadeira dona do "Escritório de Advocacia Almeida", abandonou a carreira pelo casamento, mas descobriu a traição do marido. Após o divórcio e perder tudo, ela recupera o escritório. Com a ajuda de Rafael Santos, seu admirador de longa data, vence o ex e reconstrói a vida.

title:
Do Inferno 
ao Paraíso
description: Su Xiaoxiao, uma universitária, sofre bullying constante em sua família reconstituída, e seu namorado é roubado por sua irmã. No entanto, após uma noite de sexo casual com o tio de seu ex-namorado, ela acaba engravidando. Em uma reviravolta dramática, ela se transforma em sua esposa, e seu marido começa a mimá-la sem limites.

title: Voltar ao Passado: Amor Eterno
description: Na vida passada, Estela Prado se casou com o pobre Marcelo Costa e, contra todas as expectativas, tornou-se uma dama da alta sociedade. Já sua irmã mais jovem Bianca Prado, que se casou com o oficial Leonardo Almeida, enlouqueceu após a morte repentina do marido logo após o casamento. Bianca acabou tirando a vida de Estela, mas foi morta por ela em retaliação — e ambas reencarnaram.

title: Música Boa Ao Vivo
description: Each week, IZA hosts the reunion of three guest artists who will mix and sing their songs together.

title: Marky Ramone & Tequila Baby: Ao Vivo
Sob o Mesmo Teto, Rumo ao Seu Coração
description: No aniversário de 16 anos, Fábio Alves perde a mãe e o padrasto em um acidente e passa a viver com Isabela Lima, filha do padrasto, que aos 22 anos se torna sua responsável legal. Aos 18, ele percebe que desenvolveu sentimentos por ela, mas Isabela o expulsa de casa. Quatro anos depois, eles se reencontram. Fábio agora é um ídolo famoso, enquanto Isabela administra um café, e o destino volta a aproximá-los.

title: Para Ficar ao Meu Lado (Dublado)
description: Há dez anos, Aurora Martins esperou a noite toda na chuva por um amigo por correspondência que nunca apareceu - destruindo sua fé no amor. Agora, ela se casa repentinamente com um ex-marinheiro honrado, Diogo Gaio... apenas para descobrir que ele é o homem por quem ela esperou. O destino os reune, mas será que a confiança pode sobreviver à verdade?

title: Presa ao Beijo do Rei Serpente
description: Josephine é jogada de um penhasco pela falsa herdeira que roubou seu lugar. Ela cai num poço de serpentes, onde encontra Adonis, a reencarnação de Ophion, o Deus Serpente. Uma noite proibida une os destinos dos dois. Mas, quando Adonis se esquece dela, Josephine vai perder tudo ou fazer quem a traiu pagar?

title: Sete Anos do Apaixonado ao Abusado
description: Felipe Pereira confessou seu amor de anos a Bella Lopes antes da formatura e foi correspondido. Após uma comemoração embriagada, acorda 7 anos no futuro: casado com ela e com uma filha Lara, mas tendo destruído o casamento. Com a esposa de coração esfriado e a filha muda por trauma, ele decide recuperar tudo: enfrentar a amante, reacender o amor e fazer a filha falar novamente.

title: Cozinhando Meu Caminho de Volta ao Amor
description: O chef Leon Kennedy, antes conhecido como o “Rei da Culinária”, desmorona após a morte trágica de sua esposa em um acidente de carro. Em profunda depressão, acaba vivendo em situação de rua, perdendo tudo — exceto seu amado cachorro, Dante. Um dono de restaurante o acolhe e lhe dá um emprego, sem saber quem ele realmente é. Trabalhando na cozinha, Leon enfrenta os abusos do subchefe executivo Bryant, que o humilha e desrespeita constantemente. Leon tenta se manter discreto, mas quando um empresário inescrupuloso, William, ameaça o restaurante, ele precisa resgatar as habilidades e a arte que o tornaram um chef lendário. A restauração de sua glória e alegria dura pouco: o invejoso Bryant o difama e o rancoroso William mata seu amado cão. Entre altos e baixos e mais uma devastação, o chef Leon, tomado pela dor, empunha novamente sua faca de cozinha — agora movido pela fome de vingança.

title: Love as Bright as the Stars
description: Avery Sinclair is the neglected eldest daughter of the Sinclair family. Her stepmother, Evelyn Sinclair, and sister, Peyton Sinclair, steal her medical papers and take credit for saving Carter Vance in Stonehaven. Having lost her memories, Avery returned home to seek her mother's belongings and unexpectedly reunites with Carter. However, Carter has mistaken Peyton for his savior and is engaged to her. By saving Carter's uncle, Vincent Carmichael, with her genuine medical skills, Avery slowly unravels her true identity: she isn't a biological Sinclair, but the daughter of Celine Monroe and the head of the Rockwell family. Ultimately, Avery reclaims her Sinclair Corporation shares, Peyton's fraud is exposed, and Carter realizes his true feelings, bringing the two of them together.

title: As Cariocas
description: "As Cariocas" (the women from Rio) is a dramatic comedy, presented as three different episodes, based on stories by famed (in Brazil) Stanislau Ponte Preta. Each story is adapted and directed by a different director, two of them now among Brazil's most acclaimed film makers. The 3 stories deal with the lives of 3 young Rio women. All three live in states of desperate loneliness, in contrast to the apparently vibrant social scene in Copacabana, then Rio's best and liveliest area, arguably the world's most beautiful and swinging beach scene at the time (early to late 60s).

title: As in Heaven
description: The west Coast of Iceland, late summer 1936. On a desolate farm, believed to be cursed since the 14th century, a tragic fate is about to befall the French exploration ship Pourquoi-pas.

title: As Good As Dead: AGAD
description: Eddie, the black sheep of his family, returns to his old neighborhood, after several years, to visit his mother's grave site pay his respects for the first on the anniversary of her passing. However, he's soon confronted by some enemies his past and has to deal with some old demons, putting his life in jeopardy and soon needs the help of his estranged brother.

title: As Long as They're Happy
description: A stockbroker's youngest daughter tricks an American singer into visiting her family at their suburban Wimbledon home. Her two sisters and their oddball husbands also visit, and the stockbroker notes the effect of the singer on his lovelorn family.

title: As Doze Estrelas
description: Herculano Fontes (Leonardo Brício) is a renowned astrologer called to be part of the team that will work on the next prime time soap opera. His job is to interview twelve actresses, each one representing a sign of the zodiac, to make up the cast of the prestigious soap opera. But an unexpected visit will bring trouble.

title: As pik
description: Set in the of the nineties of the past century, Bad Destiny explores the consequences of war on its protagonists and the tragedy which those people carry. Beli returns in small Montenegrin town, after years in prison. During the war in former Yugoslavia, he was a member of paramilitary unit Shadows, which participated in cruel executions.

title: As Young as You Feel
description: A 65-year-old printer hatches an elaborate scheme to avoid forced retirement.

title: As Themselves
description: A virtuoso comic theater troupe of 10 soul-mate actors, chooses to work as a co-op unit in which the members equally share all aspects of production. They all write, direct, act, and also sweep the stage after the show. After conquering the Tel-Aviv stages and achieving cult status, they dream of spreading their unique collective method internationally. However, entering their 30's, the strain of day to day life puts their principles and aspirations to the test, as well as and their friendship. This is the great experiment they staked everything on, and they know that if only they manage to stick together, no dream is beyond reach.

title: Tirar as Notas, Acertar as Contas
description: Após ser rejeitada por seus pais biológicos e desprezada pelos irmãos em favor da filha adotiva, Mariana é injustamente enviada a um centro de reeducação. No dia da divulgação do ENEM, ela sai livre, e consagrada: é a nova campeã nacional com nota máxima. Na frente de todos, durante a festa, ela rejeita a família que a traiu e transforma humilhação em triunfo.

title: As a Beginning
description: Auditions for a pantomime performance. The youths are real-life students of Yerevan's Pantomime Theater.

title: As We Forgive
description: Could you forgive a person who murdered your family? This is the question faced by the subjects of As We Forgive, a documentary about Rosaria and Chantal-two Rwandan women coming face-to-face with the men who slaughtered their families during the 1994 genocide. The subjects of As We Forgive speak for a nation still wracked by the grief of a genocide that killed one in eight Rwandans in 1994. Overwhelmed by an enormous backlog of court cases, the government has returned over 50,000 thousand genocide perpetrators back to the very communities they helped to destroy. Without the hope of full justice, Rwanda has turned to a new solution: Reconciliation. But can it be done? Can survivors truly forgive the killers who destroyed their families? Can the government expect this from its people? And can the church, which failed at moral leadership during the genocide, fit into the process of reconciliation today?

title: As Audaciosas
description: Gustavo works at a nightclub and is asked to take a group of girls to a private party on a farm. The plane they find themselves in ends up crash-landing in the middle of the forest.

title: As Neves
description: As Neves is a mountain village where everyone knows each other. The night of the Carnival, the teenagers of the village throw a party where they get high on mushrooms for the first time. The next day, they wake up to the village completely snowed in by a snowstorm and the news that Paula, one of the girls who went to the party the previous night, has disappeared. The village is getting cut off, the Internet is no longer working and it is urgent to find her. The investigation following Paula's case will cause a deep change in the villagers' lives and their relationship with the world.

title: As Long As We Both Shall Live
description: Malcolm is thrust into depression after his wife Sarah tragically dies. When he meets someone new, Nya one year later, he finally allows himself to give over to new love. And that's when he starts seeing his deceased wife, speaking to him about how abandoned she feels, terrorizing him at every turn. Every time he sees her, debilitating headaches cripple him, as well as doubts about his sanity. With the help of his sister-in-law Dee, along with his mentor Jim, he must reconcile his past with his present in order to forgive himself, mourn properly, hang onto his new love - and not lose his mind in the process.

title: As Goes Janesville
description: First General Motors shuts down their century-old plant in Janesville, Wisconsin. The the state blows up in political turmoil over the future of unions. We follow workers and town leaders trying to reinvent their town and lives amid an economic and political crisis that grips their community and the entire nation.

title: Avatars as Prostitutes
description: Multimedia artist, Piotr Kopik, has explored prostitution in the virtual world of Second Life first hand. He recorded his sexual experiences with many prostitutes and tried to get to know them as well. After analyzing his film stock, he decided to consult with authorities and experts from different disciplines, including art, religion and science. He asked them: How are sexual needs and identity changing because of technological developments? Is virtual prostitution some how real? Is virtual prostitution more acceptable because it is conducted over the Internet? Are these Internet peripheries going to transcend into the norm of virtual reality in the future? Will our sexuality move out of the real world?

description: As We Are is a reflective journey of what it was like to grow up in Peru during the 1980s, and the joyous return of the Peruvian national team to the 2018 FIFA World Cup in Russia 2018 after 36 years.

title: As High as the Sky
description: Margaret has always been a little... particular. But since being jilted by her fiance, her obsessive-compulsive behaviors are in overdrive. The last thing she needs is company. Showing up on her doorstep unannounced, Margaret's nomadic older sister Josephine (with ten-year-old daughter Hannah in tow) is initially an unwanted jolt to her carefully regulated life. But their playfulness eventually wins her over and she begins to loosen her neurotic control on life. However, when Margaret discovers the real reason for her sister's visit, she's forced to confront the betrayal... and the long suppressed grief at the root of her fastidious behaviors.

title: As the river flows
description: Abhijit Shandilya is a young journalist in his early 30's, employed with a national news magazine based in Delhi. He has managed to create a niche for himself quite early in career, through his powerful and original writings. This is one of the reasons why Anjali is attracted towards him. Anjali is Abhijit's boss and the editor of the magazine. She is a smart, young, no-nonsense woman and a tough boss. But somehow Abhijit manages to push the envelope time again and again while working on any story. Though both of them try to keep their personal and professional life apart, more often than not Anjali finds herself in tricky position at work because of him. Sridhar Rajan, head of a non-government organization & a very popular figure in Majuli in Assam - was abducted by a local terrorist organization about six years back. The story received widespread media coverage at that time. Sridhar Rajan is not yet 'officially dead' since his body is not found- although it is accepted fact amongst most that he is killed by the terrorist.

title: Trivia at St. Nick's
description: When students all flee an elite university in Vermont for winter break, the locals and faculty hunker down for their favorite time of year - the annual Christmas Bar Trivia Tournament. For Celeste (Sursok), a Type-A astronomy professor, this event combines the magic of Christmas with her greatest comfort in life: knowing the right answer. But when her colleague drops out of the tournament to do a month-long lecture tour in Asia, Celeste's team must adopt Max (Daugherty), the football team's new offensive coordinator. To Celeste, Max seems like nothing more than a grown-up class clown - though he brings an undeniable knowledge of sports trivia (a category their team has always fallen short in). Initial clashes between the two eventually turn into mutual appreciation as the team enjoys scavenger hunts on campus, decorating the international house with Christmas lights, baking Christmas cookies, and advancing toward the championship trivia game. Celeste can't help but delight in Max's infectious enthusiasm, love for all things Christmas and perhaps most importantly, his comfort with the unknown. And after a romantic wintery night at the campus observatory with Max, Celeste starts to wonder if being open to life's surprises is more important than knowing the answer to everything.

title: A Christmas Wedding
description: Emily and Ben met on Christmas day now plan to marry on this Christmas day almost two years later. Then Emily must attend work, and leaves the wedding plans up to Ben. Problems arise when procrastinator Ben tries to deal with bridesmaids dresses and dyed shoes, while perfectionist Emily is out of her mind with worry that her perfect day will be anything but. However, when a snow storm threatens to strand Emily at her work, she realizes that the only thing that matters is making it home to be with Ben and their Christmas wedding.

title: L'Enfant chanceux : De l'abandon au chérissement
description: En 1978, à Xingfu Village, Sun Pandi donne naissance à une fille, mais suite à cet accouchement, elle ne pourra plus avoir d'enfants. Elle en vient à haïr sa propre fille et, après en avoir discuté avec son mari, décide de l'abandonner dans la montagne, laissant son destin au hasard, avant d'adopter un garçon. Cependant, après leur départ, le destin prend un tournant inattendu : un enfant aux pouvoirs surnaturels, sous l'apparence d'un petit poisson porte-bonheur, se réincarne dans le corps de la fille abandonnée. Attirée par un phénomène céleste, Zhang Xiulian, la belle-sœur de Sun Pandi, retrouve et adopte l'enfant. Face au retour de cet enfant surnaturel, Sun Pandi et son mari, Zhao Gongping, le considèrent comme un mauvais présage et refusent d’accepter une fille qui coûterait de l'argent à élever. Mais grâce à la persévérance de la grand-mère Wang Guiying, l'enfant, surnommé "Fubao", est finalement adoptée par le frère aîné, Zhao Gongping, séparant ainsi l’enfant de la famille de Zhang Xiulian.

title: Edlinger, la liberté au bout des doigts
description: In the 1980s, Patrick Edlinger, nicknamed "Le Blond", painted with the grace of a poet the first chapter in the world history of free climbing. In his hands, marginal exercise became a real lifestyle, carrying a message of freedom. His famous solos, beyond the intrinsic feat they represent, bear witness to this. Life at Your Fingertips, the first internationally acclaimed climbing film, touched and inspired generations of climbers; Edlinger was one of the meteors that shone light on the cliffs of the world following the trajectory of a single idea: to be free to live only by "climbing". However, the man made concessions in the face of the necessities of life (competitions, advertisements) and pressure from the media, his public and the greed he aroused.

title: The Journey: Tumultuous Times
description: The Journey: Tumultuous Times deftly captures Singapore's historical period starting from 1941 right up to 1965. The aerial bombing of Singapore by Japanese aircraft whirls the once peaceful island into chaos. Tianpeng (Nan Xing Li) and Tianying (Allen Chen) step forward to challenge the invaders but their anti-Japanese activities soon aggravate the Japanese army and while Tianpeng manages to escape to Indonesia, Tianying is brutally slaughtered. The intensity of the story snowballs as Tianying's children Zhang Min (Felicia Chin) and Zhang Jia (Shaun Chen) lose each other while they flee from danger. Zhang Min is fortunate to cross paths with Hong Dangyong (Andie Chen) and Hong Minghui (Jeanette Aw) who stand by her during her most difficult days. With a twist of fate Zhang Jia is saved by Hu Weiren (Hanwei Chen) and grows up as the son of a man who played a part in his father's death. Zhang Jia's name is changed to Hu Jia and he soon becomes a notorious underworld figure. Tianpeng's son Zhang Yan (Romeo Tan) returns from his studies in England and joins the Legal Department as Prosecutor-a sharp contrast from Hu Jia who reigns the underworld. While their fathers had once worked hand in hand, their sons enter into unbending conflict, creating a fiercely tense outline for the show. The Journey: Tumultuous Times presents significant historical events in Singapore and displays the patriotism and devotion of the nation's pioneers, showcasing the difficult journeys they embarked to transform the island.

title: Switched!
description: Jiang Peixiang, a Chinese physician, and his wife, Liu Yujuan, have two daughters and a son. Elder daughter Xinyu helps out in the shop and is studying Chinese medicine. She is kind but ugly. Second daughter Xinhui is smart and pretty, and is a famous artiste. The Jiangs dote on Xinhui, who is a wilful and spoilt child. They also indulge their son, Zhiheng, an undergraduate who loves rock music. Xinyu, being neglected, often feels her parents are unfair.

title: After the Stars
description: A struggling starlet Tian Ai (Jeanette Aw) was dragged through the mud when a senior smeared her reputation. But in a turn of event, her reputation was revived, winning her not just fans and sponsors but also an international award. But on the day of the award, Tian Ai met with an accident and her face was disfigured - Many years later, Tian Ai has switched career and is now an artiste manager at Guo Yu's (Shaun Chen) company. Guo Yu poaches a top notch artiste manager Yi Ting (Jojo Goh), and Tian Ai often competes with her to come out top. But admiration and friendship soon develop between the two, however that was put to the test when both women fell in love with Guo Yu. Tian Ai regains the memory she lost during her accident, and remembers how Guo Yu treated her in the past. Her love turns to hatred as she sets about exacting her revenge, but when she finds out the truth behind Guo Yu's past action, she is devastated...can she still turn back time and stop the wheel of vengeance?

title: Colors of Character
description:
Steve Skipper is one of America's most prolific and honored artists. His works have hung in the Professional Football Hall of Fame, the U.S. Capitol, the International Motorsports Hall of Fame, the Birmingham Civil Rights Institute, the Paul W. "Bear" Bryant Museum, the National Art Museum of Sport, NCAA headquarters, and many other venues nationwide. They also grace the walls of private collectors and sports icons worldwide. Additionally, his inspirational Christian art has been purchased by and inspired thousands and he has been commissioned to do numerous important historical and Civil Rights works.

But there is so much more to this highly talented artist's story. First, though praised for his technical skill and creativity, he is entirely self taught. Secondly, he became one of the first African Americans to gain acceptance and financial success in the art world. Even more amazing is the fact that this gentle, soft spoken man was once a member of a violent street gang, its chief enforcer, the fierce collector of drug debts.

The big transformation in Steve Skipper's life--one that almost certainly saved his life--came at a simple church revival service, one he attended on a dare, more to mock than to listen. There, he experienced a deep religious experience that altered his self destructive path completely. He left the gang the very next day, even though that almost certainly meant death.

Now, at the command of God, he has embarked on a new and even more important artistic path. Today, with Steve Skipper's message, his success, and his talent, he inspires millions. And now, with this powerful documentary film, his amazing, true story and his powerful testimony will reach even more who so desperately need to hear his message of determination, salvation, strength through Christ, and deliverance from the demons that hold them back.

title: The Journey: Our Homeland
description: The story will stretch across 20 years, depicting the journey of Singapore from post-independence to the prosperous 80s. Zhang Jia (Shaun Chen) and Ming Hui (Jeanette Aw) are now a married couple. They are expecting the arrival of their first child but Ming Hui dies during labour, leaving Zhang Jia devastated and helpless. On the account of her friendship with Ming Hui, Yang Mei Xue (Rui En) renders a helping hand to Zhang Jia and his son. After many trials and tribulations, both Mei Xue and Zhang Jia fall in love. But Mei Xue's lover Yan Yi Sheng (Zhen Huan Zhang), whom she believes is dead, returns alive, leaving her to make a difficult choice. Hong Dang Yong (Andie Chen) becomes a lawyer and sets up his own law firm. Zhang Yan (Romeo Tan) escapes from prison and kills Dang Yong out of rage and jealousy. Zhang Min (Felicia Chin) is shattered by her husband's death, but eventually gets back up on her feet with the help of a ruffian, Dai Xiao Xiong (Darren Lim). With his help, Zhang Min opens a shop selling Peranakan cakes. Zhang Min dotes on Hong Rui (Jeffrey Xu) who is her son with Dang Yong. On the other hand, she is cold towards Hong Kuan (Romeo Tan) who is conceived after being raped by Zhang Yan. In addition, she adopts two children from the Wan Family. Singapore undergoes economic restructuring during the 70s, the Hong and Wan children have all grown up and all of them yearn for a better life. Life diverged into different paths for these spirited youths. How will they move on to strive and work towards building a blissful homeland?

title: Jump!
description: Xiao Chun Li (Jeanette Aw) is a passionate teacher in a neighborhood secondary school with rock bottom performance, both in academic results and co-curricular activities. Yan Tianfa is the KPI-driven principal newly posted to restructure and revitalize the under-performing Blue Sky Secondary. Chunli has to prove the gymnast team under her charge is worth keeping. Together with Speed, an unconventional relief teacher and five plucky students, they embark on a quest to win the first medal for the team in a national Double-Dutch competition.

title: True Heroes
description: "True Heroes" revolves around the daily lives of a group of police officers and how they reflect the need to act cautiously and advance gradually in order to avoid taking the wrong path in life. The protagonist Junhao (Christopher Ming-Shun Lee) is a righteous and courageous cop who was born into a family of police officers. Junhao graduated with top honours from the police academy and harbours the ambition to join the elite Criminal Investigation Department. He is sorely disappointed when he learns that he has been assigned to a neighbourhood police post. During a big fire, Junhao saves the life of an old lady, earning the adoration of the old lady's granddaughter, Irene (Yvonne Lim). Much to his despair, Irene tries to come between Junhao and his colleague-cum-love-interest, Kexin (Phyllis Quek). On the other hand, Junhao's colleague, Wang Feng (Allan Wu) is unable to get along with Junhao. However, Wang Feng changes his mind about Junhao when the latter saves him during a mission.

title: Find My Dad
description: Ping An grew up in a single parent family with his mother and Aunty. However, Ping Ma keeps the fact of his dads death in secret and therefore would not allow Ping An to visit his grandfather. He never gave up finding out the truth and hat was when a series of events initiated.

title: Bones S1-S12
description: F.B.I. Special Agent Seeley Booth teams up with the Jeffersonian's top anthropologist, Dr. Temperance Brennan, to investigate cases where all that's left of the victims are their bones.

title: Nobya ng Aking Kaibigan ay Aking kasintahan
description: Si Chen Guang, ang anak ng chairman ng Bihai Group, ay nasa pitong taong relasyon sa kanyang kasintahan, si Shen Liuli. Sa paglipas ng mga taon, itinuring ni Chen Guang si Shen Liuli na parang ang kanyang unang pag-ibig, na nagpapasaya sa kanya sa bawat kapritso. Gayunpaman, sa kanyang pagkabigla, si Shen Liuli ay lihim na nagtaksil sa kanya at nagplanong magpakasal sa iba. Sa kasal ng kanyang matalik na kaibigan na si Zhao Dong, hindi inaasahang natuklasan ni Chen Guang na ang nobya ay walang iba kundi ang kanyang kasintahan. Kapag nalaman ang katotohanan, hindi nagpakita ng pagsisisi si Shen Liuli. Nagpasya si Chen Guang na huwag nang magparaya. Sa pagharap sa pagtataksil ng kanyang matalik na kaibigan at ng kanyang kasintahan, marahas siyang gumanti, tinitiyak na babayaran ng mga nagtaksil sa kanya ang halagang nararapat sa kanila!

title: Ay Güey, Chicas Bien
description: Two struggling girls from different walks of life encounter a duffle bag with five million dollars cash that belongs to some gangsters. In their effort to escape the end up, inadvertently taking the identities of two heirs of a hotel emporium.

title: Sa gabing tanging liwanag ay paniniwala
description: The continuous disappearance of townsmen ignited the town captain to search the woods in order to find out who is behind the disappearances and where are the people being brought to. Upon his search, the town captain and his son came across a mysterious answer.

title: Ay Chihuahua no te rajes!
description: A father and his son fall in love with the same woman and decide the best way to solve the conflict is to fight.

title: Pinagtaksilan na Heiress ay Bumalik
description: Binalak ni Gu Yunxi na sabihin sa kanyang asawa, si Fang Yichen, ang tungkol sa kanyang pagbubuntis, ngunit sa halip, nakita niya itong kasama ng buntis na si Liu Yuru. Nalungkot, napahiya siya sa piging sa kaarawan ng kanyang biyenan at nagkaroon ng mainit na pagtatalo kay Fang Yichen, na minamanipula ni Liu Yuru. Nang magdesisyon siyang hiwalayan, pinutol niya ang kanyang nakaraan. Inuwi siya ng kanyang kapatid na si Gu Heng pagkatapos ng isang krisis, ngunit kalaunan ay nalaman niya ang kanyang pagkalaglag. Para matulungan siyang makabangon, pinaunlakan siya ng pamilyang Gu ng isang business banquet, kung saan nakatagpo niya ang pamilya Fang at si Liu Yuru. Sinubukan ni Liu Yuru na ipahiya si Gu Yunxi, ngunit inikot niya ang mga lamesa, na ikinagulat ni Fang Yichen. Nagkamali ang lahat na naniwala na si Gu Yunxi ang maybahay ni Gu Heng, at bilang resulta, ang pamilya Fang ay nagpahirap sa kanya nang labis. Sa kalaunan, natuklasan nilang si Gu Yunxi ang panganay na anak ng pamilya Gu, at napagtanto ni Fang Yichen ang kanyang pagkakamali, ngunit huli na ang lahat—imposible ang pagkakasundo.

title: Tonite with HSY
description: Tonite with HSY is a Pakistani prime time talk show on Hum Sitaray. The show premiered on Sep 13, 2014 and is presented by Djuice while produced by Hum Television Network. The show stars HSY, a prominent and most known fashion designer.

title: Flux Concert - Neuberger Museum, New York
description: Documentation of a 1983 Fluxus concert performed by a collective of the eponymous international network of artists at the Neuberger Museum of Art in Purchase, NY.

title: Black, Not Gray: Ankara Rocks!
description: The story of the rock and metal music scene in the '80s and '90s in Ankara, the capital of Turkey -- the city which is deemed to be 'gray', considered as 'lifeless', 'soulless' and 'dull', and labeled as a 'city of politics' -- and a band's attempts to get out of it despite their love of their hometown.

title: Tatli Kaçiklar
description: The inseparable mates Rafet and Saffet are two clever and clumsy journalists who work at a newspaper's sports service. One is a newspaper photographer and the other a sports writer. Though they are inseparable, they have totally different personalities.

description: "Willkommen im Club" shows the influences of unemployment (actually the number one theme in Germany) on daily life. title: Swerte ay um-ARRIVE para kay ISHIRO ng WRIVE
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

#TNT10NationalFinals
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Irreversible Choices
description:
Irreversible Choices is a harrowing film that deals with a number of existential themes, including notions of home, family upheaval and personal destruction.

Dante Kathlego (John K-ay) is married to Alisha Kathlego (Suzan Mutesi). As a result of his poor health Dante loses his job. This causes some friction between husband and wife, but Alisha still decides to travel to Melbourne to promote Dantes new novel. Dantes health condition is so serious that he is unable to drive. Whilst his wife is away, Dante enlists the help of his best friend Mike (Joshua William Parker) to be his driver and companion. However, Mike is reckless. He is known to take risks and put himself, and others, in serious danger. Dante tries to educate Mike about the danger he puts himself in when he these risks, but Mike doesnt listen!

Whilst in Melbourne, Alisha meets the rich, handsome and dangerous Nate (Scott Murphy). He convinces her to abandon her children and family. This choice begins a chain reaction of violence, death, heart break and trauma. No one is left unharmed by these irreversible choices.

title: Professor Mia
description: Professor Mia's private counseling session turns a student's punishment into a forbidden affair — until the principal walks in and demands her share of the discipline.

title: Bella, my step-daughter
description: His wife flies out for two days and asks him to look after Bella, her grown-up daughter. Bella still calls him Daddy, and she has her own idea of what looking after her means. Two days, one house, and a flight that gets canceled.

title: A sírásó
description: A stranger comes to town in this adaptation Rainer Maria Rilke short story, and gets a job as a gravedigger - and the adoration of the local bigwig's daughter. She spends entire days with him in the cemetery garden, talking about death and dying. A plague befalls the town, sparing only a few, leaving them the task of pushing coffin-laden wagons to the cemetery. The film uses the same camera that records horse racing photo finishes; it does not provide the feeling of space like an ordinary film or photographic camera. Gravedigger lacks the illusion of movement typical of most films. Photographed images track from left to right across the screen. Deformed and fuzzy, as if shot by a trembling hand, the images look like blurred film frames, moving too slowly to create the impression of movement, sometimes forming surreal or abstract compositions. The director takes the audience to pre-Lumière cinema to experience motion picture construction (panoramas) and narration.

title: A Mão e a Luva - The story of a book trafficker
description: He defines himself a trafficker, but he have chosen a drug that renders free. He is a book trafficker.

title: A Moreninha
description: In 1866, during the anti-slavery movements, a romantic young lady, who lives on Paquetá Island, meets her childhood love again, who is now pursued by another young woman who does not spare efforts to be beside the man she loves.

title: A bocados
description: The chef Ander González and the nutricionist Gabriela Uriarte host a daily cooking show with information about food, health and family.

title: A Ferreirinha
description: the life of Antonia Ferreira (popularly known as "Ferreirinha") from her widowhood to her death, including her role in the production and marketing of the Port wine.At the same time it's told the love story between Camilo Castelo Branco and Ana Plácido.

title: A Rock and a Hard Place
description: A Rock and a Hard Place is a portrait of Red Lake, a small Northwestern Ontario community built atop one of the world's richest underground gold mines. The film examines a modern-day gold rush as residents reflect on the boom and bust grind of life in a gold mining town. Following the extraction of gold from 7000ft underground to the surface, voices from the deep reveal a community long-dependent on a single resource; including the threat of relocation due to open-pit mine development.

title: Chesty: A Tribute to a Legend
description: A tribute documentary on the most decorated U.S. Marine, General Lewis B. 'Chesty' Puller.

title: A Bird in a Guilty Cage
description: Sylvester Cat spots Tweety Bird in a display window of an after-hours department store and sneaks inside through a mail server chute. Tweety flees Sylvester by hiding in a hat pile and a doll house, evades the shots from a rifle Sylvester uses, and escapes in a vacuum tube. Tweety sends a dynamite stick through another tube, and Sylvester swallows it, thinking it is Tweety. The dynamite blows up inside Sylvester after the cat leaves the store and walks down the street.

title: A Demonstration
description: "A Demonstration" is a monster film with no monsters. Inspired by the existence of taxonomies of monsters at the heart of Early Modern European science, the film explores and reinterprets a way of seeing the natural world that is almost impossible to imagine from today's vantage point. Early Modern naturalists were guided by a logic in which scientific truths were discovered through visual analogy. The word 'monster' comes from the latin 'monstrare', meaning to show, to reveal, to demonstrate. "A Demonstration" picks up on these themes in a poetic exploration of the boundaries of sight and the metamorphosis of form.

title: Come on in, We're Dead
description: The true story of the The Young Brothers Massacre, 1932. The record for the most lawmen shot dead in the history of the United States. 10 cops and one civilian in Springfield, Missouri went to arrest 2 small-time gangsters known as The Young Brothers. The young men (Harry, 25 and Jennings, 30) had been on the run for the murder of a town marshall 3 years earlier. The Sheriff, Marcell Hendrix, had been neighbors with the fugitive?s family and late father in particular, so he didn't expect any trouble. As a consequence, they showed up at the family farm with nothing but the six-guns on their belts, and little to no additional ammo, In spite of the fact that the boys were well known for their marksmanship. The farm was on a large open piece of land with a scattering of trees around the farmhouse. When the Sheriff and his deputy pushed in the door, a massacre ensued, The officers would become trapped behind those trees, as the brothers systematically picked off the officers from the cover of the dark farmhouse.

title: The X Life
description: When you think of extreme sports you think of highly competitive, tatted-up, bad-boys with little regard for their own safety whose sole mission is to push the limits of physics beyond the edge of what is thought possible. But there's a whole other layer that fuels their cutting-edge quest -- the gorgeous, fearless, women who love them. Together these two elements merge to form the nucleus of VH1's newest original series "The X Life." "X Life" will follow some of the biggest names in action sports: Pierre Luc Gagnon (Vert Skater) and his girlfriend Denise Russo; Cory "Nasty" Nastazio (BMX Dirt Jumper) and his girlfriend Nicole Panattoni; and Jeremy "Twitch" Stenberg (FMX) and his wife Susie Stenberg. All of these men have earned their place in the sports history books. As for the ladies, they have their own careers from helping to manage and market their husband's careers to being a top model to being a mom. But when these guys are on tour you can bet the women are nearby as these guys are always on the edge of being seriously injured or worse. These wives are fiercely protective, defensive and ready to throw down at a moment's notice. And if your husband isn't on the tour, good luck breaking into their clique. title: Julio y su ángel
description: Julio is a small boy in Mexico who loses his mother. As she is dying, she promises him that she will send him an angel to take care of him. He is put in an orphanage that is nothing more than a work house. Julio escapes and meets up with some street-wise kids and they go around stealing wallets and purses from the tourists around town. Julio is remembering his mother's promise while praying at the church and a man appears as he is leaving. The man's name is Angel. Julio begins to follow Angel around and eventually they become friends and Julio moves in with Angel. Meanwhile, the owners of the orphanage are looking for Julio and continue to search for him throughout the movie. During Day of the Dead festival, Angel teaches Julio how to honor the dead as they honor Angel's wife. She has no gravestone, but they outline her grave with candles and play her favorite music. Finally, Julio convinces Angel to arrange an "escape" of his friends at the orphanage in order to take them to the Christmas fair. While having fun at the fair, the orphanage owner catches up with Julio and threatens to take him back to the orphanage. Angel comes to his rescue, and in the ensuing fight, Angel is stabbed with a knife. In the final scene 10 years later, Julio, who is now a soldier, visits the grave of Angel. Julio remembers him with candles, lavish gravestone and the music that Angel played for his wife.

title: Am I Perfect?
description: In a star studded world of crazed pop culture, social media domination and celebrity fixation, where appearance infatuation has become an obsession, it is not surprising that one in three young Australians say that body image is their top concern. The media affects our ideas of who we are and who we could be, so much so that looking at fashion magazines for just three minutes lowers the self-esteem of over 80% of women. As a 19 year-old university student with everyday female insecurities, Director Madeleine Humphreys, recognised that she - like a majority of females within her age group - can't help to feel overwhelmed and unattractive when comparing herself to broader society's definition of beautiful. Am I Perfect? follows the journey of Madeleine, as she sets out on an all-consuming quest in an attempt to obtain Hollywood 'perfection'. In this self-transforming exploration, Madeleine pushes herself to the limits over ten weeks to see if she can achieve 'perfection'. Madeleine sets out to discover if she could ever feel more than just 'average'? Could she, like a celebrity on a red carpet or a model on a runway, present herself to a large crowd of people and feel beautiful? Existing on meagre celebrity rations, extreme exercise regimes and grueling beauty treatments her journey takes her on a self-inflicted physical and emotional roller coaster where she discovers her own worse enemy in this plight for perfection is herself. With health and fitness experts advising her to stop, yet image-obsessed society screaming more. Madeleine discovers how dangerous and physically unattainable perfection is.

title: An Engineered Dream
description: Career decisions in India aren't an individual's choice. Parents, extended families and society at large groom the kids for a predestined career path of engineering or medical science, said the fastest way to start earning good money. They send their children to the hub of coaching institutes, Kota, a city in North-west India. More than 200,000 teenagers in Kota live in cubicle size rooms and study 15 hours a day to prepare for the entrance exam to top colleges with an acceptance rate of less than 1%. The education pressure among students in India is so horrendous that more than 75,000 students had committed suicide between 2007-2016. An Engineered Dream follows the life of four such teenagers in Kota.

title: Sharing an Island

Together they travel across divided Cyprus. They argue from different perspectives of history, share stories of the past and together they envision the future. Will they succeed in breaking down prejudices and be liberated from the traumas of the past that have been passed on to them? Will they discover truths they had never before encountered? Is peace a long way ahead?

title: An American Opera
description: In the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina, America suffered the worst domestic animal crisis in its history. Tens of thousands of house pets were left to perish in neighborhoods all across the gulf when the owners were forced to evacuate without their pets. Tom McPhee went to Gonzales, Louisiana not knowing how he would help, just knowing he needed to help somehow. He volunteered at the Lamar Dixon Expo Center and by chance found himself spending the next four days taking picture after picture of thousands of house pets rescued from flooded New Orleans. For the next 16 months Tom would document this historic event as it unfolded, trying to understand where it all went wrong. An American Opera is an unflinching, operatic vision of what happened to the people of New Orleans who were forced to evacuate without their beloved pets. Follow the story of the Pets, Vets, Owners, Officials, Rescuers and Adopters of animals as they all work through the chaos to do what is right only to discover not everyone is working toward the same goal!

title: An American in Madras
description: An American in Madras primarily traces American-born filmmaker Ellis R. Dungan's years in India. Dungan made India his home from 1935-50 and became a celebrated director in the Tamil Film Industry based in South India. Born in 1909 and hailing from Barton, Ohio, Dungan reached India on February 25th, 1935 intending to stay for 6 months but ended up staying for 15 years making 13 feature films, 11 in Tamil and one each in Telugu and Hindi. During this period, he brought many technical innovations to the developing Tamil Film Industry of the 1930s and '40s, and infused a sense of professionalism into its filmmaking. All this, without understanding a word of the language! Dungan also served the Madras Government in World War II. He directed photo features, newsreels and wartime propaganda films and recorded historic events in India's history around the period of her Independence. The film traces Dungan's Indian connection right up to 1994, when on a trip to India, the Tamil Film Industry felicitated him in Madras for his contribution to its development, a good 43 years after he had left India!

title: The Piano: An Odyssey
description: Filmmaker Michelle Cameron heads back to her childhood home to claim her family's piano. She starts a compelling journey in Orlando, Florida where she unites with her family as they prepare to part with the piano that has borne witness to their lives over the past three decades. With Brooklyn, NY as the final destination, Michelle heads on the road; inviting musicians along the way to take part in the piano's final journey. 'The Piano: An Odyssey' explores the deep rooted experiences that connect us all. It's more than just a road trip. It's the navigation of a complex family that shows our capacity for forgiveness and the courage to prevail in the face of hardship.

description: The story begins with the queen bee hive being attacked and destroyed by an army of wasps, which kill almost all the bees inside and devour their eggs. title: Tall as Trees
description: Jude, an 8-year old Amerasian boy, leads a life of privilege in the Philippines. After Jude's father William, an American expat from Boeing, receives a promotion in Seattle, he breaks the news that Jude and his mother Maria will soon follow. Jude and Maria are vexed to leave their home island but the strength of family spurns them on to a new life. En route to Seattle, Jude and Maria stop at the US Embassy in Manila to obtain the final immigration papers. A violent typhoon floods the city and separates Jude from his mother, changing his life forever. Alone, hungry and disconsolate on the streets of Manila, Jude seeks help from a crooked cop, Amador, and runs into a street kid, Bhotong, who demands a price for being in his territory. Jude quickly learns he must be wary and trust no one. After an ethereal apparition of St. Michael delivers Jude from the malevolent 'Kapre' of his dreams and folklore, Jude meets Shutoy and a unlikely but unbreakable bond of friendship forms. Shutoy, a street smart boy, shows Jude not only how to survive on the streets but how to love life there. Soon, Jude and Shutoy meet Mira, a young girl who teaches both boys how to find beauty even when it seems there is none. Through his friends, Jude endeavors to make enough money to find his way home to his father in America. William searches desperately for Jude but cruel twists of timing and the greedy dishonesty of Amador lead to an overwhelming collision that changes everyone involved forever.

title: Kris at Beauty
description:
Tumatalab na ba ang pagkain ng grapes sa ilalim ng mesa noong New Year? Here's to manifesting an organic encounter para sa puso mong naghahanap ng forever! At para mas intense ang 'feels' in the air, gawing real-life background music ang "Umpisa," na collab nina Moira Dela Torre at Adie.

Nakaka-soft naman ang mga boses na 'yan! Samahan pa ng lyrics na silang dalawa mismo ang bumuo, ay, feeling alive talaga ang puso. Ano bang kwento sa likod ng joint single na 'to a.k.a. ano bang tumatakbo sa isip nina Moira at Adie habang sinusulat ang lyrics? At malay n'yo, from "Umpisa," magkaroon din ng "Gitna" at "Wakas."

Dahil January 21 ngayon, isang rock 'n roll na Happy Birthday, Jugs Jugueta! Heto pa ang isang milestone–Ryan Bang, kinilala bilang bahagi ng Top 10 ng 2025 Korea National Image Survey, or the Top 10 public figures positively influencing South Korea's global image. Kahanay lang naman niya ang BTS at Blackpink!

description: When socialite Helen Stevens obtains a job on a New York newspaper, she is met by much derision from the staff. Befriended by a heavy-drinking reporter named Jack Rawson, Helen rises to the position of advice-to-the-lovelorn columnist. One night Helen is assigned to a missing-girl story, and Jack promises to accompany her. However, he gets drunk instead, and later, awakening from a stupor, he stumbles upon the scene of a murder. Slipping into unconsciousness again, Jack awakens the next morning to find himself accused of the killing. Helen, with the aid of one of her lovelorn letters, investigates the story and uncovers the real murderer. Jack reforms and Helen takes him home to meet her mother.

description: Body at Large intends to explore the problems of prohibition, limitations and discrimination faced by people of borderline gender. Its protagonists include the veteran Taiwanese film critic Alphonse Perroquet Quail Youth-Leigh, muscular LEE Yao, transvestite AG and the transgender performance artist James CHEN. title: Last Day at Lambeau
description: What if the pride of a community hinged on the demise of their greatest hero? Brett Favre was the pride of Wisconsin for sixteen years until he left after a messy conflict with the Green Bay Packers. When he sought the opportunity to play for the Packers' arch-nemisis, the Minnesota Vikings, the people of Wisconsin turned from adoration of Favre to hatred. LAST DAY AT LAMBEAU explores this complex relationship between fans and pro athletes and the specific events which defined the war between Brett Favre, the Packers and Packers Nation.

title: Gorilla Bathes at Noon
description: A major of Red Army is late for the train that takes Soviet's forces from Berlin. He telephones to Moscow and finds out that his wife has left him and that someone has moved in his apartment. He decides to stay in Berlin and does so by staying in no man's lend between two Berlins. His only property is small tea-urn, parade uniform and white bicycle. His first contacts are with black market and underground. And while he makes first moves in the game of survival, we're getting to know his past.

title: Together
description: The story begins in 1967 where Singapore has just gained independence, in the downtown area along a bustling street, 6 families cramped into 3 houses. It is also here where 6 aspiring youths dreamed about their future...Xiao Bei, the only son of a tailor, is a trouble-maker in the neighbourhood, he does not want to confine himself to the tailor shop and daydreams about striking it rich one day. Xiao Bei's childhood sweetheart, Jian Hong, drops out of school at a young age and peddles medicated oil in the streets with her father. A more down-to-earth person, her only hope is for Xiao Bei to inherit his father's trade. Zhi Hao is a fickle-minded young man, although he is often in loggerheads with Xiao Bei, they always stick by each other through thick and thin. Zhi Hao's sister, Jin Hao, is both vivacious and naïve, despite her unrequited love for Xiao Bei, she remains a loyal friend. On the other hand, Jian Hong's twin brother, the timid Wu Ji is secretly in love with Jin Hao. Hui Min is the only one among them who is highly educated, though she is physically weak, her perseverance paid off and she eventually becomes a lawyer. Through 30 years of changes, from the hardships of starting out in the 60s, the oil crisis in the 70s, to the stock-market crash in the 80s, Singapore have weathered the storm, and so has these friends through 2 generations of joy and sorrow.

title: The Journey: A Voyage
description: Beset with foreign threats and internal turmoil, China's concoction of woes compels its citizens to leave for Nanyang in search of a better life. When Shi Tou (Desmond Tan), manages to save enough money after years of working at a tin mine, he returns to marry his childhood sweetheart, Ya Zi (Jeanette Aw). On the return trip, they cross paths with two penniless brothers, Zhang Tian Peng (Nan Xing Li) and Zhang Tian Ying (Allen Chen) with the former becoming Shi Tou's sworn brother out of gratitude. Framed for robbery and murder, Shi Tou is thrown behind bars while Ya Zi desperately seeks help. Feeling sympathetic towards them, Hui Niang (Joanne Peh) and her stepbrother, Zhang Dong'en (Elvin Ng) proves Shi Tou's innocence. When he returns back to the mine, Shi Tou is lured into a destructive spiral of gambling by his scheming boss and runs up a huge debt, while his supervisor, Hei Long (Pierre Png) lusts after Ya Zi's beauty and plots to ruin him. When Zhang Tian Ying is apprenticed to an elderly herbalist who passes on to him the fruits of his research, he eventually sets up a highly successful medical firm with his brother. Zhang Guang Da (Terence Cao), Dong'en's uncle, poisons him and his mother in a bid to take over the family business leading to her death and Dong'en's imminent demise.

title: Saphai breu... aw aw
description: Nuan, a pretty nurse is engaged to Chai, a son from the wealthy Wongwuttiporn family which owns a huge mansion, which is eventually given to the young couple as a wedding gift. Meanwhile, Khun Ying, Chai's mother, plots to take the mansion back for herself in order to trade it to someone to get money for her debts. In order to do so, she has to get rid of Nuan. Unexpectedly, Nuan is killed and comes back to the mansion as a vengeful ghost to haunt Khun Ying and the people who caused her death.

title: [ENG DUB] My Five Guardian Dads
description: Just because she was a helpless orphan, her mother-in-law insulted her, her husband had an affair with a rich girl, and even forced her to divorce and give him the house left by her mother! As she lay helpless on that rainy night, suddenly five men claiming to be her fathers appeared, one was a billionaire real estate tycoon, one was an international movie star, one was a world-renowned top doctor, one was a top scientist, and one was the leader of a global mercenary organization! Then she gradually learned the story of her parents. It didn't matter who her real father was, what mattered was that her fathers loved her and spoilt her, helped her get back at the bullies, and made her life smooth sailing from then on to the top of the world!

title: Gonjeshkak -e Ashimashi
description: A movie of three episodes. In the first episode a woman has to return her little girl who she gave away back home. In the second episode Nafas: the story of a 15 years old mute girl who her father wants to force her marry a young mute guy Ali Reza. In the final episode Ddead End: a 15 years old boy Jalil who recently released from the prison is searching for his mother who now is married to another guy.

title: Who the F... Is Roger Rossmeisl
description: The life of the only guitar maker who worked with the three legendary companies, Fender, Gibson and Rickenbacker: German born Roger Rossmeisl.

title: We Are Not Ghouls
description: US Air Force JAG Attorney Yvonne Bradley was assigned to defend a man held at Guantanamo Bay. Believing Guantanamo held "the worst of the worst", her world was turned upside down once she arrived in Cuba and began to untangle an unimaginable case.

title: So, I Can't Play H
description: Ryosuke Kaga unwittingly strikes a deal with Lisara Restole, a seemingly divine being. However, she's actually a Shinigami, a Death Goddess, leading to grave consequences.

title: Crveno i crno
description: A painter comes to the hospital for scanning, believed he has cancer. He carries a gun to shot himself just in case if it proves that he's right. When the results turn out to be negative, he's perplexed because it's actually life that is rigorous, and should he use his weapon anyway.

title: I Married Black
description: A White guy marries a Black woman, concealing his narrow views involving race.

title: I Do? I Die! (D'yos ko day)
description: Domeng (Babalu) and Mokong (Redford White) plan to get revenge on their cruel boss Bernie (Edu Manzano) but it will lead to helping rebuild their former boss' family.

title: Natt i hamn
description: Early 1940s, during WW2, pitch black waters except for a moon-shadow over the waves. Surrounded by minefields and the fog slips in the sweeping headlights of the cargo ship S/S Rune. But the ship bows relentlessly forward through the night.

title: I Spy
description: A pair of intelligence agents posing as a tennis pro and his coach go on secret missions around the world.

title: Dom i khozyain
description: Former front-line soldier Yegor Baynev returns to his native village to his mother, wife and children. To buy a cow and build a new house, he is forced to go to work. Gradually money becomes more important to him than family.

title: I Believe
description: A 9-year-old boy experiences God's power in a supernatural way.

title: Hwarang: The Poet Warrior Youth
description: Revolves around an elite group of male warrior youth called Hwarang who grow through passion and love in Seorabeol, the capital of the ancient kingdom of Silla.

title: Baalveer 5
description: Baalveer is the son of Adishi and is a boy from Udaka-Lok, a sister planet of Shashvan-Lok, the capital of righteousness. Baalveer is given some powers by Uttan, the ruler of Shashvan-Lok. On the other hand, a evil power Aagil, the empress of Himbash-Lok turns out to be successful in generating an ultra-weapon, named Mahajadoo, to kill the Baalveer. Uttan arranges Kasam Kaal for Baalveer to give all Baalveer's powers to him, so that Baalveer will be able to defeat Aagil. Baalveer calls Uttan, Adishi, and Shashmaad (Uttan's assistant) to come to Shatr-Ghar (weapon house; a place where Uttan keeps weapons of evil forces after defeating them) and deceptivates the weapon of Aagil that she used to kill previous Baalveer by touching him the weapon and turns him into ashes. Baalveer told them that he is ready to fight the evil forces.

title: Agent 6
description: After completing a secret mission for his agency, an agent must make the decision between delivering the enemy device to home base or to go back and save the girl he left behind.

title: Queen Charlotte: A Bridgerton Story
description: Betrothed against her will to King George, young Charlotte arrives in London on her wedding day and faces scrutiny from the monarch's cunning mother.

title: The Seven Deadly Sins [English] S1-S5
description:
When they were accused of trying to overthrow the monarchy, the feared warriors the Seven Deadly Sins were sent into exile. Princess Elizabeth discovers the truth - the Sins were framed by the king's guard, the Holy Knights - too late to prevent them from assassinating her father and seizing the throne!
Now the princess is on the run, seeking the Sins to help her reclaim the kingdom. But the first Sin she meets, Meliodas, is a little innkeeper with a talking pig. He doesn't even have a real sword! Have the legends of the Sins' strength been exaggerated?

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: 7 seX 7
description: An Croatian erotic anthology of seven short stories directed by Irena Skoric, all revolving around sex and relationships. Five of the stories following the intimacies of straight couples, where the 6th and 7th stories revolve around a lesbian couple and a gay couple.

title: Andha 7 Naatkal
description: A Tamil Cinema First. Introducing the first-ever telescope-based movie in the Tamil film industry a groundbreaking narrative that blends science, faith, and love. Can a man, through the sheer power of his love, change what even God cannot?

title: Mega Man 7
description: Six months after his imprisonment, four of Dr. Wily's robot masters activate, attack the city, and free the mad doctor. While battling Wily's forces, Mega Man encounters a strange and powerful second warrior-hound duo: Bass and Treble.

title: Protocol-7
description: With the catastrophic regression of her adopted son, Lexi, a small-town lawyer, is confronted with the reality of corporate fraud at the highest level. Will she hold a massive corporation accountable in this true whistleblower story?

title: Experiment 7
description: Dr. Felix Copper is a doctor of Biological Sciences and is on a quest to find a solution to purifying radiation from water in the year 2022, ten years after the fall of humankind. He has to travel to the far outreaches of every city known, trying to make his way to the coveted underground lab, if the Mutants don't get him first. Along the way he meets some unwarranted friends, Sam and William, two off the cuff heroes who cause more problems than they fix, and Aco, a super-model turned weapons expert. Together, Dr. Copper just might survive long enough to find a cure.

title: 7 miljonärer
description: Two Brothers arguing about the money left by their parents

title: Project 7
description: When you work for Project 7, if you leave, you die, it's a rule. Project 7 is the secret intelligence agency that performs inhumane experiments to see just how far the human population can go. By learning how to break down individuals defenses, they can further strengthen their own nation and army. But what will happen when a new employee Angel who has full intentions of bringing the firm down, suddenly falls in love with everything that she despises? Will the firms lead researcher, Dylan Wright be able to walk away from all that he is and all that he knows to save the life of the woman who tries to destroy him?

title: 7 Wonders
description: 7 Wonders is an documentary that aims to show how we're all connected, by asking 7 people from 7 countries 7 questions.

title: Code 8: Part II
description: Follows a girl fighting to get justice for her brother who was slain by corrupt police officers. She enlists the help of an ex-con and his former partner to face off against a highly regarded and well-protected police sergeant.

title: 9-Month Stretch
description: Ariane Felder, a judge of strict morals discovers she's pregnant by Bob Nolan, a criminal wanted for murder.

title: 9/11 Whistleblowers
description: "But someone would have talked," say the self-styled skeptics who believe the government's official conspiracy theory of 9/11. "After all, every major conspiracy has its whistleblowers, doesn't it?" But there's a problem with this logically fallacious non-argument. "Someone" did talk. In fact, numerous people have come out to blow the whistle on the events of September 11, 2001, and the cover-up that surrounds those events. These are the stories of the 9/11 Whistleblowers.

title: RiffTrax Live: Plan 9 from Outer Space
description: Hosted live from the Belcourt Theater in Nashville, the RiffTrax team riffs on "Plan 9 from Outer Space (1958)" yet again while also tackling the short subject "Flying Stewardess". Guest stars are Veronica Belmont, Jonathan Coulton and Rich Kyanka.

title: Lauren Harries: Working 9-5
description: Lauren Harries: Working 9-5 follows one of TV's most eccentric celebrities, as she attempts five mystery jobs in forty hours; under the watchful eyes of five top mentors.

title: Live at 9:30
description: Live At 9:30 is a fast-paced modern variety show starring the best performances from the legendary 9:30 Club in Washington DC and special guests Hannibal Buress, Henry Rollins, NPR's Bob Boilen and many more.

title: Kishkindhapuri [Hindi]
description: During a ghost tour, visitors enter an old radio station where they disturb a dormant spirit. Now trapped inside, they must find a way to escape as supernatural forces threaten their lives.

title: Skilda världar
description: Two twins, Daniel and Sandra, are separated when very young as their parents split up without any contact for nearly 20 years. When they meet by chance on their 20th birthday this drama series starts, and the first main storyline is whether or not they will get to know that they are related. Their two families (of different world, hence the title) are upper and middle class. Daniel's brother Mikael elopes with Anna to live as outcasts, as Anna's mother blames Daniel and Mikael for the murder of her husband. Andreas is revealed as the real killer, but doesn't succeed in proving to the court that the death was an accident, so Andreas has to spend time in prison. His girlfriend is Daniel's and Mikael's sister Stina, who is torn between her family and boyfriend.
