title: Life as Ritual
description: This is the story of an extraordinary woman, Kunsang Wangmo, a 102 year old Buddhist nun from Tibet. When she turned 6 years old she decided to become a nun. She later married a Tibetan monk and gave birth to 2 children. In 1959 when the Chinese invaded Tibet the family ran away to India. There one of her child and her husband died. She was left alone in exile with one daughter. Both underwent many hardships, had to work in road construction, were living in primitive tents, sometimes starving. Then in 1972 Sonam fell in love with a Swiss student who studied anthropology in India. They got married and he took them both to Switzerland. In all these years living in Switzerland Kunsang never gave up her clerical life. She follows her daily religious practices. She is still at age 102 independent and full of vitality and 'joie de vivre'. No complains and gossiping about other, no depression, no sullenness. Kunsang ist not a heroine but a role model for many in showing us how you can age in dignity and autonomy even though she has lost not only her family but her country and freedom.

Nothing to Laugh About
description: Kasper is a comedian who has everything he could wish for. That all changes when he is diagnosed with a serious illness and his girlfriend leaves him. Using humour as a disarming and life-giving force, he discovers a new side of himself.

title: In Search of Haydn
description: In this eagerly-awaited documentary, Phil Grabsky's biographical account of Haydn's life is a visual and aural extravaganza, including breath-taking performances by some of the world's most celebrated musicians.

title: The Peppercorns
description: Several children investigate cases in their city together.

title: Ceviz Agaci
description: Hayati is a small-town literature teacher and a one hit wonder author who tries helplessly to hold on to his past: his shattering marriage, his sick old mother, a decaying walnut tree and the memory of his father. Instead of moving on with his life and taking control, he passively accepts its blows and is only interested in digging into the past, until his discovery forces him to confront his own weakness and answer the question: is standing idle while witnessing evil being done is just as much of a sin as doing it?

title: Lefter: The Story of the Ordinarius
description: An aspiring footballer defies his strict father to chase his dream, navigating challenges in family, love, and identity - all in the name of greatness.

title: A contratiempo
description: After the premiere in Madrid of "Cae la noche", the latest film by filmmaker Félix Ortiz, he embarks on a trip to Galicia. By distancing himself from his usual surroundings, he tries to find a new story to tell. At a stop on his route, he meets Clara, a teenager who travels aimlessly and who convinces him to accompany him for part of the journey. After several frustrated attempts to get rid of her, Félix ends up accepting that Clara goes with him to Finisterre.

title: A Love Like a Fading Heartbeat
description: Cold and untouchable CEO Sonny Quipp was cursed from birth—his pure Yang body doomed him to die before thirty. Desperate to survive, he discovers that Nora Giles, a struggling college student, is the only person in the world with a Yin body that could save him. Determined to cheat fate, Sonny forcefully takes Nora as his wife. But when he learns that saving him will cost Nora her life, love and destiny collide, forcing him into an agonizing choice between her heartbeat… and his own.

title: A Wizard’s Love Spell with A Billionaire
description: After a fierce battle, powerful sorceress Elizebeth Starwhisper is hit by a rival's spell and sent across time and space to the 21st century, into the body of drowned heiress Elizabeth Rockfield. Revived suddenly, she has to adapt to survive. She learns modern money-making secrets and applies her mystical skills cleverly. Meanwhile, her arranged-marriage husband, Frank, LA's youngest billionaire, realizes his "wife" is like a new person and, for the first time, he's falling in love with her…

title: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie S1-S2
description: In the If You Give a Mouse a Cookie series, based on the book series by Laura Numeroff and Felicia Bond, the main characters are Mouse, Pig, Moose, Dog and Cat and several humans. The episodes revolve around their adventures.

title: Il m’a humiliée sans savoir que je suis l’héritière cachée
description: Il m’a humiliée publiquement devant tous les invités, persuadé que je ne suis qu’une fille pauvre et sans protection. Il n’a aucune idée que je suis l’héritière cachée d’un immense empire familial. J’ai choisi de vivre incognito pour tester les gens, mais son arrogance et ses insultes ont dépassé toutes les limites. Quand je dévoilerai enfin mon identité, il comprendra l’énorme erreur qu’il a commise, et il devra payer cher chaque humiliation qu’il m’a infligée.

title: From Today, I'm the Richest
description: Exhausted delivery driver Zhang Chao meets a mysterious beggar after an injury and gains a fortune from his future self. Rising to become the richest man, he unknowingly pays for success with his life.

title: Beauty ni Gibi, agaw-pansin sa Miss Q&A!
description:
Maningning ang pagsisimula ng Tuesday sa “It’s Showtime.” We choose happiness, and we choose a fun jamming with Jan Roberts at Lola Amour with their song "Tapos Na Ba Tayong Dalawa."

Times four ang tawanan dahil sanib-pwersa muli ang quadro nina Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro sa paboritong "It's Showtime" segment na Miss Q and A.

Times three naman ang wit at good vibes na dala nina candidates Labinya Winter, Valerie Evangelistar, at Gibi Esguerra who made the FUNanghalian extra interesting dahil sa mga talak nila na 'it's giving.'

Habang kinikilala ang mga kandidata, nalaman ni Vice Ganda angbpagkahilig ni Gibi sa luxury items, kaya hate niya si ‘judith.’ Payo naman ni Meme Vice, mag-impok lalo na sa kalusugan dahil walang tao na hindi nagkakasakit. Health is wealth, ‘ika nga.

Sa Wit Lang, sina Labinya at Gibi ang nag-face off. Dahil sa LOVE-an na LOVE-an niyang kasagutan, with lots of love na tinanggap ni Gibi ang korona as today's Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Make sure you are always smiling para dumapo ang blessing. POT question ay dapat masagot nang tama para ang premyong inaasam ay ma-achieve sa Laro Laro Pick. Tourism students ng NCR ang bumida sa game arena.

Si Maica, kabado for today’s video. Pero nawala ang kaba nang tabihan ni jowa. Madlang People ay kinilig kina Maica at Cris at sa kanilang kuwentong pag-ibig.

At ang harana ni player Ainsley, nauwi sa busking. Ang galing! Para bang may swerteng dala ang boses niya, dahil si Ainsley ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round. Tama ba ang napili niya?

title: Allsång på Skansen
description: Allsång på Skansen is Sweden's longest running music-show in both radio and TV. It's been aired in the summer at Saturday's for more than 70 years (with a couple of breaks between 1952 - 1955 and 1967 - 1973). It started on the radio in may 1935 with the singing teacher Sven Lilja (host: 1935 - 1951), at the microphone in front of a live audience. The songs were handed out at the entrance. And at that time where people singing folk-songs, ballads and songs with patriotic spirit. And Lilja was followed by Egon Kjerrman (host: 1956 - 1966) who changed the repertoire towards evergreens and left after 10 years without a successor. As his motto was: -' sing rather than good. So then was the show cancelled until 1974 when it was given a new life with Bosse Larsson (host: 1974 - 1993). And then was it still only a radio-show. But Bosse fought it could work on the national television broadcast service (SVT). So the first episode aired on SVT 1 in 1979, and since 1985 has it's been aired live during the Swedish summer whit different hosts after Bosse Larsson did his last episode in 1993, and made his blessing to Lasse Berghagen (host: 1993-2003), how started to have international artist (as Ricky Martin and Wyclef Jean).

At one point, Devaduta starts hearing a voice that she identifies as the 'Voice of God'. She escapes from her home, to find employment as a cleaner at a dance academy. The guru at this academy identifies a spark in her and trains her, to see her blossom into a danseuse par excellence. With her fame and fortunes, Devaduta goes on to build an Ashram to help needy children, while being constantly guided by the 'Voice of God'. Her social work and the fact that she hears 'the Voice of God' gets her the epithet of 'The Prophet' from the people. However one day the voice tells her she has a year to live, and this realization completely shatters the equanimity of Devaduta. At the center of this system is Victor, a calculating and emotionless ruler who seized power by killing his own father and reshaping the city into a controlled empire. A brilliant scientist, Victor conducts secret experiments to evolve humanity, viewing individuals as expendable components in a larger design. As Cyrus moves closer to exposing the truth, he becomes a target. A series of orchestrated events leads to the apparent loss of his wife, pushing him into emotional collapse. Consumed by grief and rage, he is drawn into a hidden program that promises strength but conceals a far darker purpose. Within a secret facility, Cyrus undergoes brutal experimentation, granting him enhanced regenerative abilities tied to fluid absorption and augmenting his body with partial mechanical strength. The transformation changes him. No longer bound by law or restraint, Cyrus escapes and unleashes chaos upon the very system he once served. As he tears through criminal networks and corrupt forces, the city begins to fracture under his actions. To some, he becomes a symbol of justice. To others, a monster. Amid the destruction, a young scientist named Arlos emerges, offering Cyrus a chance to stabilize and evolve his abilities further. Together, they uncover deeper layers of Victor's plans, including contact with extraterrestrial forces that threaten to reshape the future of humanity itself. As tensions rise, Cyrus learns that not everything he believed is true. Hidden truths about his wife and the system force him to question his path. title: Marupok nga ba si Kim Chiu?
description:
Para sa maraming empleyado, it's payday dahil unang ‘a-kinse’ ng taon! Maraming ‘pumaldo’ sa unang sweldo this 2026! Kaya payo ni Teddy Corpuz, maging maingat sa mga online transactions dahil baka mabiktima ng scammers. Kaya naman si Jackie Gonzaga, ‘na-trigger’ at humugot!

Samantala, siksik sa kulitan ang ‘Laro-Laro Pick’ game arena kasama ang mga madlang players na taga-Valenzuela. Lahat ng naka-hoodie, pumila para sa 'Not Cute Anymore' trend! Nakilala rin natin si Lao, na inspiring ang positivity sa kabila ng pagkakaroon ng tumor. Present din si Ferdie na para bang karakter sa "FPJ's Batang Quiapo" ang pormahan. Si Ambel naman, tricycle driver, sobrang komportable sa game arena na para bang kasama lang niyang tumambay ang mga ka-toda.

May mga espesyal pang bisita! Nakilaro rin sina Gladys Reyes at Neil Ryan Sese, na nag-enjoy pa rin kahit na-eliminate agad sa unang round. Pabiro pang tinalakan ni Gladys ang nag-o-operate ng ilaw sa ‘Illuminate or Eliminate’ game.

Siksik sa kulitan ang ‘Laro-Laro Pick’ game arena kasama ang mga madlang players na taga-Valenzuela. The luckiest of them all ay si Jose, isang janitor at mapagmahal na ama sa dalawang anak at asawa sa misis na 'caregiver.'

Para sa Li-Pot offer, dinoble nina Kim Chiu at Jackie Gonzaga ang buwanang sweldo ni Jose, kaya may P30,000 na pwede niyang tanggapin. Matagal-tagal din pinag-isipan ni Jose ang pipiliin. No'ng una'y nag-Li-Pot siya, pero nakumbinsi ni Vice Ganda na mag-Pot sa dulo kung saan P200k ang katumbas ng tanong na, "Ano ang ibig sabihin ng 'Q' sa QR code?"

"Quality," sabi ni Jose. Pero hindi ito ang tamang sagot. Para pasayahin si Jose, nangako si Vice na bibigyan niya ito ng pang-grocery para may maiuwi pa rin sa kanyang mag-iina.

One plus one equals intense bosesan sa tanghalan. Sa Day 4 ng "TNT Duets 2" weeklong Grand Finals, dinala ng tatlong duos sa isang musical adventure na may iba't ibang 'feels' sina hurado Kyla, Erik Santos, Yeng Constantino, Jonathan Manalo at Punong Hurado Louie Ocampo.

Unang sumabak sa entablado ang 'Dua Bisdak' Juliana Tagalog at Shane Castillo. Fierce ang kanilang tunugan sa pagkanta ng "Marupok" ni KZ Tandingan. Speaking of "marupok," tinanong ni Vice Ganda si Kim Chiu kung marupok ba ito. At ang sagot ng

Chinita Princess, "I'm just a loving person." Oh, pak! Eh, kung si Darren Espanto ang tatanungin, ayun ‘napaamin.’ Saan nga ba marupok si bestie Darren?

Samantala, komento ni hurado Yeng, "Mayroong parts sa umpisa na medyo nadumihan talaga ako." May 'kakampi' si Yeng dahil sumang-ayon sa kan'yang opinyon si hurado Kyla, na pinayuhan sina Shane at Juliana tungkol sa "slurring." Kumontra si Erik, na sinabing hindi siya "nadumihan" but he found the performance "dragging." Ang markang nakuha ng Dua Bisdak ay 91.2%.

Sa digmaan sa tanghalan, magkasangga rin sina Thor Valiente at Pia Carandang a.k.a. 'TNT Bestmates' na pinakilig ang lahat sa kanilang "'Til I Met You" performance na nakatanggap ng standing ovation mula sa mga hurados. Inilarawan ni Maestro Louie ang pag-awit bilang "creative" at "hard to beat." Pakiramdam naman ni hurado Jonathan ay para siyang nanonood ng pelikula sa tila movie soundtrack na performance. Parang na-senti nga raw si hurado Erik kahit wala namang pinagdadaanan. Nakakuha ng score na 96.8% ang TNT Bestmates.

Hard to beat man ang naunang duo, hindi nagpatinag sina Jezza Quiogue at Ian Manibale a.k.a. 'Jezzian.' Ang hugot hit ni Moira Dela Torre na "Ikaw At Sila," ginawa nilang mas mapanakit pa.

Mahaba-haba ang naging diskusyon ng mga hurado. "Parehong heightened ang emotions." Ipinaliwanag ni hurado Jonathan na hindi sila nakapag-standing ovation kina Ian at Jezza dahil sa sobrang sakit ng awitin. Mas tumaas pa ang tensyon at excitement nang sabihin ni Maestro Louie, "Para akong nanganak ng kambal. Hindi ko pwedeng iwanan 'yung isa. Magkaiba pero pareho 'yung pagmamahal sa dalawa."

title: Ako ba ang nasa puso mo?
description: Abraham's wife dies in a hospital after giving birth to a son, Ariel. Abraham (Abe) is the head of a household. Biring, a housemaid, gave birth to a girl (Theresa) shortly after a few months. Theresa and Ariel grew up together. One day, Theresa's parents left for the province due to illness in the family. title: ...Sabik kasalanan ba?

title: Bha. Bha. Ba.

title: Ba... ni hao ma
description: A father can have many different kinds of faces. Which one does your father have? This is a film of ten short stories, and each shows a different relationship between a father and his son. Each story reveals the complexity between fathers and sons.

title: Angel-A
description: Desperate to escape the clutches of a crime lord to whom he owes money, André almost ends his life to put himself out of his misery. But at the last minute, he runs into Angel-A, a mysterious woman who helps him get a new lease on life.

title: A Stray
description: A young Muslim refugee in Minneapolis crosses paths with a stray dog.

title: A Reservation
description: Four friends and their professor are headed to a Native reservation when a run-in with a satanic cult alters their trajectory. Witchcraft, black magic and some sick billionaires put them onto a path of unspeakable terrors.

title: A Fuga
description: In the 1950s, a handful of prisoners attempt a daring escape from Peniche, a castle on the north coast of Portugal for the political dissidents of the regime.

title: A Man and A Woman
description: In the early spring of 2021, a man and a woman flew to Hong Kong at the same time, and while waiting to enter the mainland, they stayed in the same hotel, separated by a wall. During the short intersection of their lives, the two confided in each other about the pressure they were burdened with and found a spiritual harbor in Hong Kong, where tenacious vitality was blooming. And before the answer is revealed, the choice stops abruptly.

title: Jaan-E-Bahaar
description: Kuku Rai belongs to a wealthy family, and lives with her businessman dad and housewife mom. Since she is of marriageable age, her parents want her to get married to a young man named Ajit, who also comes from a wealthy family. But romantic and adventurous Kuku refuses to do so, and runs away from home. On the run she meets with a truck-driver named Gopal alias Gopi and both of them fall in love with each other. Then Kuku finds herself locked in a barn, and after a few days the door is opened by none other than her dad, who tells her that Gopal had claimed a ransom of Rs.17,000/- for her safe release. Subdued, after her tryst with romance, Kuku agrees to marry Ajit. But fate has other plans for her, when she finds out that Mr. and Mrs. Rai are not her biological parents, but they may have sired a young man who they decided to abandon years ago. The question remains, will Kuku's marriage take place with Ajit now; will she ever come to know who her real parents are; and who exactly is the son of Mr. and Mrs. Rai.

title: Minha Irmã e Eu
description: Two sisters are forced to bond after many years apart when their mother goes missing.

title: Dokhtar-e Sheytan
description: The story of the devil's daughter who is seeking for God's forgiveness, comes to earth to find a way to make up for what her father has done. Trying to find a medium to compensate for her dad's wrongdoings, she finds a man who must help her.

title: Amor e Sangue
description: Sophia parte em busca da irmã gêmea desaparecida, Tina. As pistas a conduzem ao Véu Rubro, um exclusivo clube noturno para vampiros controlado pela implacável família Von Drák. Ao entrar nesse mundo sombrio e sedutor, Sophia descobre uma profecia assustadora, um romance proibido e uma guerra sobrenatural que ameaça destruir a todos.

title: Traída e Vingada
description: Gwen Goodall confundiu Genzo Storey com seu salvador e fez de tudo para ajudá-lo a ganhar a coroa, mas ele a retribuiu com traição e matou toda a sua família. Após pular para a morte, Gwen se viu de volta três anos atrás! Determinada a reescrever o destino, ela procurou o deposto Príncipe Herdeiro Eugene. Enquanto o ajudava a recuperar o trono, descobriu uma verdade chocante—Eugene era seu verdadeiro salvador! Agora, Gwen estava pronta para virar o jogo e fazer seus inimigos pagarem!

title: The End of the F***ing World [Hindi] S2
description: James is 17 and is pretty sure he is a psychopath. Alyssa, also 17, is the cool and moody new girl at school. The pair make a connection and she persuades him to embark on a road trip in search of her real father.

description: Fairy tales collide when Mambo and Munk tip the scales of good and evil once again. This time Princess Snow White is a misguided teenager who'd rather have fun with friends Red Riding Hood, Goldilocks and Little Bo Peep than help peasants. When Snow White's father is matched up with Lady Vain - a scheming witch brewing to rule the kingdom - Snow White becomes a thorn in Lady Vain's side. Snow White is soon tricked by Lady Vain (with Rumpelstiltskin's help) into spreading vicious gossip about the townspeople, forcing her to flee. Through rebuilding the three little pigs' houses with the seven dwarves leading the way, Snow White learns the value of helping others. Only Snow White can foil her dad's wedding to stop Lady Vain. With Mambo and Munk in tow, Snow White proves she can rule the kingdom, while bringing balance back to the scales of good and evil.

title: Miss Q&A: Ilan talaga ang pangarap ni Angeline Quinto—ISA o SAIS?
description:
Perfect sa panahon ang chill jamming with James Reid and Maki, na nag-collab sa kantang "luck." Ay, feeling lucky ka for sure dahil pinagbigyan nina James at Maki ang request na mag-"Oooh Lala Baby." Pati ang tinaguriang Overtime Diva ng "It's Showtime" na si Trina, join sa nakaka-"Oooh Lala " na sayawan!

Babad na babad sa wit at tawanan ang Miss Q and A segment. Parang kidlat na lumiliwanag sa kalangitan ang kagandahan nina Kim Mancilla, Queen Barbie Marie, at Queen Mathilda na may magkakaibang lakas at talento.

Pwede kang ma-lost in her eyes pero hindi malo-lost in translation kay Kim, ang multi-lingual girlie ng grupo. Bagay naman sa nakaka-senti na weather ang hugot ni Barbie Marie sa kanyang spoken word poetry. At hindi takot bumoses ang social media influencer na si Mathilda.

Parang kidlat, dapat mabilis ang pagpindot at tama ang sagot sa 'Tumpak Ganern' round, dahil kung hindi, uuwi kang lotlot. Ligwak man siya sa kompetisyon, with grace and confidence pa rin ang pag-exit ni Barbie Marie, na nangakong babalik siya for her redemption.

Sina Kim at Mathilda ang umabante sa 'chukchakan' sa Wit Lang Round. Pero bago ang Q and A, sina Ryan Bang at Ion Perez muna ang magbibigay ng jokes na havey. Pinagpuyatan ni Ryan ang mga jokes niyang may bitaw, pero may ilan na nabasag lang. Kaya hirit ng oppa, na-stress siya at baka bukas um-absent na!

Back to the competition, nabunot ni Mathilda ang tanong na, "Sa kanta ng Aegis, sino ang mas lutang—'yung nananginip nang gising o nakatulala sa hangin?"

Tumapat naman kay Kim ang tanong na, "Sa kanta ni Angeline Quinto, ilan tlaga ang pangarap niya—isa, o sais?" Tuloy ang pangarap ni Kim sa Miss Q and A dahil siya ang kinoronahan na Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Believers of second chances and never-give-up attitude ang mga ALS (Alternative Learning Syestem) students ng Taguig na naki-join sa Laro Laro Pick. At second chance nga ang dumating kay Clarisse, na na-eliminate man no'ng una, nabunot pa rin ang pangalan niya para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Sa aktingan naman, sino nga ba ang bibigyan ni Jackie Gonzaga ng chance? Si Darren Espanto at Brent Manalo?

At second chance nga ang dumating kay Clarisse, na na-eliminate man no'ng una, nabunot pa rin ang pangalan niya para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Litong-lito at gulong-gulo ang puso ni Clarisse kung susugalan ba ang POT o tatanggapin ang offer sa Li-Pot. Pero sa dulo, umuwi siyang panalo.

title: Speaking Through the Silence
description: Nearly sixty years after Alfred C. Kinsey researched what people do sexually in his Kinsey Reports, social psychologist, David W. Wahl has devoted his life and research work to understanding human sexuality. "Speaking Through the Silence" follows Wahl from a speaking engagement in Havana, Cuba, through the heartland of America, to the Coastlines of New York and California where we are witness to his work first-hand while he talks to the average person about their sexuality and how their lives have been affected by societal perceptions. Through this documentary, the viewer is exposed to the realities of human sexuality and the detrimental effects placed on those who reveal non-normative sexual behaviors. David W. Wahl demonstrates where we are sexually in society and where we need to be for people to lead complete lives.

title: District Zero
description: Maamun opens the door to his shop, like he does every other morning. It is a tiny white container. Next to it is an identical container, and then another, and another. Thousands of containers stretch as far as the eye can see, all of them exactly the same. We are in one of the biggest refugee camps in the world: Zaatari, in Jordan. His shop repairs mobile phones. Maamun starts to serve his customers. Their memory cards contain their past in Syria: happiness, routine, family life. And then the war came, followed by destruction, fear and flight. Maamun rebuilds photos and sound, recovers lost content, recharges batteries, and restores the only link his neighbours still have with Syria. He and his friend Karim have decided to provide a new service: printing off the photos which have filled up the mobile phones of the people who live in Zaatari. Through his routine, the conversations with his friends and neighbours, the daily life in his tiny shop, we discover that no-one wants to print off photos of the war; there is much more to the refugees' sense of identity than that. They want to remember, they want to emphasise their Syrian identity, their identity as individual people. The photographs printed off in Maamun's shop every day not only make us ask questions about the identity of the refugees, but also about our own identity: who are we? Why are we here? Where were we born? Where will we die?

5+5+ takes a personal and good humored look into the universe of contemporary art in Brazil. Taking a 1967 print by artist Carlos Vergara as its starting point, the film captures how this specific work participated in the personal histories of the various people who own it today.

Having inherited a print from the series Five Problems, Five Illustrations (1967), the scriptwriter together with the director of the film, dig up its genealogy, investigate the context in which it was created and the impact its various copies have had on the lives of the people who have had them hanging in their homes through the years. Through touching interviews and abundant never before seen archival footage, the documentary paints a multifaceted picture of Brazilian society and its art scene in the late 1960s in light of the recent military coup and ensuing censorship. Interviewees include artist Carlos Vergara, experimental film director Ivan Cardoso, and a slew of surprising characters who through the most varied circumstances came into contact with this work in their lives.

title: Gölge Planlar ve Ay Işığındaki Gerçek
description:
Xiao Meng, babasının yasak ilişkisi yüzünden parçalanan bir ailede büyür. Annesi depresyona girip yaşamını yitirirken, üvey annesi ve üvey kız kardeşi Xiao You ona her fırsatta zorluk çıkarır. Tüm bu talihsiz olaylara rağmen, Xiao Meng azmi ve yeteneği sayesinde ünlü bir moda tasarımcısı olmayı başarır.

Kendisini yetiştiren teyzesine maddi destek sağlamak için, Xiao Meng onun yerine zengin Gu Nan Cheng’in evine hizmetçi olarak gider. Ancak bilmediği şey, üç yıldır çevrimiçi arkadaş olduğu “Ay Işığındaki Centilmen”in aslında Gu Nan Cheng olduğudur. Gu Nan Cheng, uzun süredir Xiao Meng’e karşı duygular beslediği için gizlice ona iş hayatında ve özel yaşamında yardımcı olur. Üvey kardeşi Xiao You, defalarca Xiao Meng’i sabote etmeye çalışır; ne var ki Gu Nan Cheng her seferinde duruma el atarak sorunları çözer.

Sonunda, Gu Nan Cheng kalbini açıp Xiao Meng’e duyduğu sevgiyi itiraf eder ve evlenme teklifi eder. Xiao You’nun entrikaları da ortaya çıkar ve başarısız olur. Böylece Xiao Meng, büyük acılarla geçen hayatının ardından hem kariyerinde hem de aşkında mutluluğu yakalar.

After the passing of his wife, encouraged by an old friend, he embarks on a journey of blind dates. He encounters four potential partners along the way. A considerate nurse leaves due to housing issues, a female scientist quietly departs after her cancer recurrence, a union leader's dominance causes psychological strain, and a partner who closely resembles his late wife presents a difficult request. These different emotional experiences lead to Shen Zhuoran's personal growth, and his reflections on love and life also deeply impact his family members who accompany him on this journey.

title: Iboga Green
description: Initially coming for his studies to France, Mike quickly joined the Kartel after losing all the financial support. Driven by the instinct of survival and attracted by ease, he had the idea of creating a new drug by mixing narcotics with Iboga, a psychoactive African plant. Mike's "La Green" became a commercial success almost instantly.

title: Jack Be Nimble
description: Jack be Nimble is a film about a group of young men traveling across the country in a beat up RV in order to compete in a series of stunt inline skating competitions. They belong to a small subculture of athletes that has been banished from the now mainstream world of extreme sports. Along the way they try to establish their community as a 'real' sport deserving of respect from mainstream culture, while at the same time discovering that the activity which once represented rebellion, innocence and individuality has brought them to a crossroads between growing up and following their passion.

title: Let's Be Frank
description: Meet several Bullitt owners across all generations, hear their stories, and tag along on a journey down Route 66 to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the movie Bullitt.

title: To be or not to be Ivan Hiti
description: Croatia (Pakrac), Winter 1992. Serbo - Croatian civil war is in progress. A soldier of the Croatian army Ivan Hiti received the order to burn the oldest and largest library of the Serbian Orthodox Church in Croatia. Rather than destroy the library, he organized the sheltering and moving book in Zagreb. Upon returning to the unit due to not obeying orders, was expelled from the army, is expelled from work and never worked in the public service. On the local radio station was declared a traitor, he had been threatened - Twenty years after the war ..

title: Be Kind
description: A touching documentary about diversity through the gaze of children.

title: Be Somebody
description: A comedy about Ted, feeling trapped in his marriage, desires the single life enjoyed by his best friend Colin. In pursuit of this dream, but left by Colin to sink or swim, Ted struggles through a series of hit and miss experiences in a twisted journey involving insane women, an ex-wife reveling in his failure, and a girl down the hall being stalked by her ex-husband. Ted finds himself, without knowing he was ever lost.

title: Mrs. Judo: Be Strong, Be Gentle, Be Beautiful
description: Mrs. Judo- Be Strong, Be Gentle, Be Beautiful documents the life-long journey of Keiko Fukuda's decision to defy thousands of years of tradition, choose her own path, and become the highest-ranking woman in judo history.

title: Don't Be Tired!
description: A Canadian couple, Roman (Jalal Fatemi) and Maria (Ghogha Bayat) visit Shahdad, an Iranian desert in Kerman province. They have an uneasy relationship over the death of their son but they are hoping to mend it on this trip. They hire two young men to guide them but have a car breakdown. The situation gets complicated when Roman separates from the group and disappears into a Qanat well.

title: Truth Be Told S1-S3
description: Truth Be Told is short film about a couple cleaning out there closets on their way to a healthy relationship, so they hope.

title: The Rock 'n' Roll Dreams of Duncan Christopher
description: The awkward son of a rock legend, Duncan Christopher, works through the suicide of his father in the brutal underground world of karaoke.

title: Aumenta que é Rock'n'Roll
description: Luiz Antônio, a clumsy radio host, unexpectedly finds himself in charge of a bankrupt radio station. With a very crazy team, he creates one of the most emblematic radio stations in the history of Brazilian rock, Fluminense FM.

title: O Poeta
description: O POETA Marco Nicoletti's synopsis Junior would like to be a poet full-time, but he did not publish big thing, and is not really recognized in the Sao Paulo's poetry crowd. To contribute to maintain his small family (his wife Helena with whom he has an one-year-old baby girl, Aurora), he spends time showing apartments to customers who avoid them. As a matter of fact he's as much "successful" in the real estate as he is in the poetry... But the life in Sao Paulo is expensive, and his wife begin to worry about the incapacity of her husband to face reality... One day Junior purchases a ticket of the national lottery, and hide it in the shelves of the living room. Few days later, when he discovers that he eventually won the lottery, the ticket is lost... The Poet describes junior's increasing obsession for the lottery ticket, and its descent in the sheer madness. He eventually looks for the promised ticket in the dump of Sao Paulo (one of the largest on western world), and writes to the president Dilma, to get back the money he deserves. His desperate search allows us to make also an investigation on the emergent artists of contemporary Sao Paulo.

title: Sen o Warszawie
description: Czeslaw Niemen, who died ten years ago, was an icon for several generations of Poles. In Poland under communism he managed to raise popular music to the rank of true art; he also won renown abroad. He was born in 1939 in Stare Wasiliszki (today's Belarus) and his biography was largely shaped by the tempestuous history of this part of Europe. The film is a portrayal of the charismatic musician, made up of unique archive materials and reminiscences of his family and friends.

title: Univers(o) Pecanins
description: A portrait of the Pecanin sisters, prominent figures in Catalan and Mexican arts and culture, ten years after the closure of their renowned art gallery.

title: O Palhaço Atormentado
description: A clown is abandoned by his wife, who leaves their paralyzed daughter for him to take care of.

title: Fonazei o kleftis
description: A lost wallet that finds one evening an honest accountant becomes the occasion to reveal a wide abuse.

title: O teleftaios gyrismos
description: Alexandra and Orestes, a handsome young couple, arrive from Athens, to spend the summer holidays with Orestes' family at a beautiful picture-perfect seaside town on Cyprus.

title: O Grande Kilapy
description: Zézé Gamboa's sardonic historical drama follows a good-hearted, apolitical con man who, on the eve of Angolan independence in the mid-1970s, pulls off a massive swindle at the expense of the Portuguese colonial administration.

title: O Grande Irmão
description: With confidential and unpublished documentation, the film shows the background and behind-the-scenes of the coup in Chile that took place on September 11, 1973 - and General Pinochet's dictatorship, which lasted 17 years.

title: O Corpo Aberto
description: Miguel, a teacher, assigned to a creepy village feel's a fascination for Dorinda, who has an affair with Mauro who was found dead hanging from a cherry blossom tree. Miguel begins to suspect that his soul is still roaming the village.

title: O Grande Elias
description: When Mr. Elias discovers that his aunt, who lives in Brazil, comes to visit him, he decides to temporarily occupy the house of a wealthy neighbor who's away so that she doesn't discover that he's not as rich as he told her.

title: O Velho Fusca
description: A sensitive 18-year-old strikes a deal with his hard-edged grandfather to earn a forgotten 1976 VW Bug. As they clash over pride and masculinity, restoring the car forces them to confront old wounds and redefine what it means to be a man.

title: Todo o Nada
description: Debido a la crisis miles de obreros se encuentran desempleados en la ciudad de los vientos Chicago. Desesperado y encarando muchas deudas incluyendo la posible perdida de su casa, Willy decide reclutar a un grupo de amigos para poner un show de strippers y asi reunir el dinero necesario. Pero para asegurar que esto sea todo un exito deben quitarselo - todo o nada!

title: O casa Aparte
description: Sibiu/Romania, one of the richest cities in Romania, has been chosen to be the European Capital of Culture 2007. The entire city has become a construction site. Right in the middle of all this is 70-year-old Ioan Drasovean, an old man trying to keep up with the drastic changes in his country. He lives in a small flat in a run-down house, a strong contrast to the magnificent renovations all over the city centre. We follow Ioan in his everyday life: at home or sitting on a bench in the park; in serious discussions with his friend Ilie or others; discussing Putin, Castro and mobile phone charges; and an old vacuum cleaner that needs to be fixed. This is a film about everyday-life in Romania, its problems and its hopes. And about how communism gave up because it was clever.

title: O Lucky Man!
description: An ambitious coffee salesman has a series of improbable and ironic adventures that seem designed to challenge his naive idealism.

title: Até o fim: o jogo do predador
description: O caso ardente da amazona Jade Zeller com o implacável CEO Easton Quinn termina com um acordo milionário. Surpreendentemente, ele é o noivo de sua meia-irmã maldosa, e o homem que a persegue é o sobrinho dele! Com os inimigos à espreita, Jade vira o jogo e se torna uma caçadora sedutora, enquanto Easton perde o controle nessa tentação proibida. Neste perigoso jogo de manipulação, quem é a verdadeira presa?

title: Tzak, o kavallaris
description: An ambitious Greek expatriate who returned home broke after sixteen years in the United States sets his sights on a multi-million heist, unbeknownst to him that a nefarious mobster and his gang are after the very same target.

title: PaPa (O naanna)
description: Young love, unexpected pregnancy, and the challenges of teenage parenthood test the limits of Manikandan and Sindhu's love as they raise their son. Adithya

title: Anaganaga O Dheerudu
description: In a teardrop-shaped land called Sangarashtra, a 9-year-old girl with special healing powers tries to save her homeland from the tyranny of an evil queen with the help of a blind swordsman.

title: Davidam o davidam
description: A Japanese actor and runner decide to run around the entire world from his country Japan to the west and then back to the east. But when reaches the borders of Iran he finds out that he has cancer. When enters Iran he faces some events which affect him and his illness.

title: Tumi O Tumi
description: Tumi O Tumi is about the conflict between 'inner you' and 'outer you', an women faces all the time in her lifetime.

title: Disc-O-Teen
description: A hosted live dance program with John Zacherle as "Zacherley" on WNJU-TV Channel 47 Newark, New Jersey during 1965 to 1967.

title: O Herdeiro Miniatura
description: Paula Sousa, a filha mais velha da família Sousa, julgou mal Marcos Machado, um canalha, e após sofrer sua traição, ficou desiludida e com o coração partido. Num momento de descontrole, embriagada e buscando diversão, ela trompeu, sem saber ao certo, com Jefferson Antunes, o controlador do Grupo Antunes. Ela, no entanto, pensou que ele era apenas um funcionário da boate. Entre eles, a atmosfera ficou carregada, a paixão incontrolável... Mais tarde, Paula Sousa, grávida, foi abandonada pelo noivo canalha. Sua própria irmã e família aproveitaram a oportunidade para oprimi-la. Ela deu à luz e criou sozinha quintupletos. Hoje, ela retorna imponente com os bebês fofos. Inesperadamente, as crianças, por uma coincidência do destino, encontram seu pai biológico, Jefferson Antunes, e embarcam numa jornada para ajudar a mãe a conquistar e capturar o coração do pai presidente. A família, juntos, passa por muitas coisas e, no final, vive feliz para sempre.

title: Kababalaghan o kabulastugan?

title: Confiesa o choca
description: Toda la familia estaba en un viaje por carretera cuando, de repente, los frenos fallaron en la autopista y el auto quedó bloqueado a 150 km/h. Las puertas no abrían y la señal estaba bloqueada. Una extraña voz masculina en el sistema de infoentretenimiento del auto anunció el inicio de un juego: si dicen la verdad, la velocidad bajará 10 km/h; si mienten, aumentará 10 km/h. Infidelidad, espionaje, aventuras secretas, un caso de asesinato de hace diez años... los secretos de todos en el auto se van revelando. ¿Quién controla realmente este auto?

title: Terapia Proibida: O Pacto com o Diabo
description: Chloe Evans suporta anos de abuso emocional de seu marido, Mark, desenvolvendo uma aversão sexual. Pressionada a iniciar uma terapia agressiva, ela conhece o Dr. Victor Thorne — secretamente o CEO que Mark está desesperado para impressionar. Para encobrir um desvio de fundos de 300 milhões de dólares, Mark oferece Chloe como moeda de troca. Após flagrá-lo traindo, Chloe faz um pacto sombrio com Victor: ela mesma em troca da ruína total de Mark. Eles destroem Mark, que é humilhado publicamente e preso pelo FBI. Mas Chloe descobre um arquivo confidencial: o plano de três anos de Victor para dobrá-la e controlá-la. Recusando-se a desmoronar, ela faz um backup secreto de seu trunfo e contra-ataca. Em vez de sentir fúria, Victor fica cativado pela ferocidade dela e cede. Chloe visita Mark na prisão para um último golpe psicológico e, em seguida, faz sua estreia como Vice-Presidente Executiva em um baile de gala de Wall Street, ao lado de Victor no auge do poder. De vítima indefesa a rainha do abismo.

title: [dublado] O Dote Que Desfez o Amor
description: Após ser enganada pela própria família, Nora Wood engravida de Tyler Holt, e o filho deles é chamado Bryan. Infelizmente, quando Bryan completa cinco anos, é diagnosticado com leucemia. Para cobrir as despesas médicas, Nora decide vender o pingente de jade da família que Tyler lhe deu, desencadeando uma busca por Bryan pela família Holt em toda a cidade. Enquanto isso, Nora se junta ao Holt Group como secretária de Tyler. À medida que trabalham juntos, seus sentimentos um pelo outro crescem, e o relacionamento deles floresce com o tempo.

title: O Marido Imprestável Dela É o Príncipe Élfico
description: Por amor, Serion abriu mão das asas e do título real. Mesmo assim, foi traído pela esposa e pelo filho e acabou sendo torturado pelo Povo-Fera por três anos. Quando finalmente decidiu ir embora, eles descobriram que o homem que haviam descartado era o Príncipe Élfico. Mas o arrependimento veio tarde demais.

title: O Casamento do Meu Alfa, O Meu Funeral (Dublado)
description: Helena foi a Luna da Alcateia Blackwood e a companheira destinada de Alexandre por metade da vida. Quando ele morreu, cartas secretas revelaram que ele amava outra. Renascida no dia em que ele traz sua ômega amada para casa, ela não vai repetir a tragédia. Agora, ela romperá o vínculo, ganhará sua liberdade: o casamento dele pode ser seu funeral, mas não o seu fim.

title: Win, Lose, or Draw Straws
description: Win, Lose or Draw Straws is a rare political film that brings together left, right, center and agnostic by exposing a little known oddity in US electoral politics, the existence and resolution of races that end in perfect ties. Travel the country meeting those who's fate, representation and policy decisions that affect real lives comes down to a coin flip, straw draw, card game or another "game of chance". In a time where politics is incredibly high stakes, solving important races with a coin flip is an unimaginable reality for most casual observers and political junkies alike. This roller coaster ride through local politics all the way up to presidential campaigns seeks to inspire change in our electoral system as a whole and personal behavior of citizens by shining a bright light on the importance of individual citizen participation in selecting our leaders.

description: Julio Ulloa is a boy who has had very little luck in his life so far. He has done everything, like working on anything or the first thing he finds. title: Amor y Frijoles

title: Tocar y luchar
description: To Play and To Fight presents the captivating story of the Venezuelan Youth Orchestra System - an incredible network of hundreds of orchestras formed within most of Venezuela's towns and villages. Once a modest program designed to expose rural children to the wonders of music, the system has become one of the most important and beautiful social phenomena in modern history. The documentary portrays the inspirational stories of world class musicians trained by the Venezuelan system, including the Berlin Philharmonic's youngest player Edicson Ruiz and world renowned conductor Gustavo Dudamel. With interviews with many of the world's most celebrated musicians including the great tenor Placido Domingo, Claudio Abbado, Sir Simon Rattle, Guiseppe Sinopoli, and Eduardo Mata, To Play and To Fight is an inspirational story of courage, determination, ambition, and love showing us that... only those who dream can achieve the impossible.

title: Verdades y Mentiras

title: Santo y el águila real
description: Wealthy landowner La Tigresa suffers several attacks and seeks help from Santo. The attacks continue, but Santo protects her and she falls for him.

title: Esposa Lista y Letal
description: La asesina Jiu Yue viaja en el tiempo y es entregada en matrimonio a Ji Yiqing como "esposa de la suerte". Pero esta aparente doncella es en realidad una letal asesina.

title: La impostora y el trono
description: El CEO de Grupo Nubemar, Mateo, viaja y deja a Lucía al mando. La pasante Marina finge estar embarazada y se hace pasar por la esposa para humillarla y sabotear un contrato clave. Al volver, Mateo destapa la farsa: Marina es amante de su hermano adoptivo estéril. Desesperada, intenta apuñalar, pero fracasa y acaba ante la justicia. Mateo y Lucía terminan juntos.

title: Renací y dejé de perseguirte
description: José, el heredero oculto de los Herrera, ama a Tina, la hija de su chofer, que lo traiciona y lo arroja de un techo. Él renace antes de que todo empiece. Esta vez, la expone, le quita todo lo que le dio, y corona a Ana en una gran gala donde la mentira de Tina se desmorona. Al pedirle matrimonio, Ana confiesa que no renació: lo esperó 125,600 años.

title: Amor y Engaño
description: Raúl Quijas era un médico ginecólogo. Durante una cirugía de aborto en el hospital de maternidad e infantil al que fue enviado como apoyo, descubrió inesperadamente que la mujer en la operación era su propia esposa, Maite López. Resultó que la esposa con quien había prometido pasar el resto de su vida ya había cambiado de corazón y le había sido infiel con otra persona.

title: Mi fiera y su malcriado
description: El emperador ordena a Marian casarse con el príncipe Harlan. Tras ser traicionada y envenenada por él y su prima, Marian renace el día del decreto. Con esta segunda oportunidad, rechaza a Harlan y elige a Julian, el infame mujeriego de la capital.

title: Renacer y convertirse en leyenda
description: Carson, último heredero del Linaje Imperial Ascendente, es traicionado y obligado a autodestruirse por los Tres Señores Supremos. Tras renacer a los 20 años con sus recuerdos intactos, jura vengarse. Con la ayuda de Víctor Yates y su familia, Carson desenmascara a su ex manipuladora, aplasta a élites arrogantes y derrota al Gran Maestro Cyrus. En su ascenso al poder, se convierte en la figura más temida de Newhaven, listo para reclamar su lugar en la cima.

title: Kokoro y el viento del otoño
Me echas, y pierdes
description: Elena Morales, antes protegida y diseñadora principal de la poderosa Familia Muñoz, es despojada de todo y expulsada tras ser traicionada por su prometido, Javier Muñoz, quien elige a Aurora Cardona en su lugar. Humillada y sin nada, Elena recibe una oportunidad inesperada de Luciano Cifuentes, heredero de la rival Familia Cifuentes, y pronto se convierte en su diseñadora principal. Años después, al alcanzar la cima junto al Grupo Cifuentes, Javier descubre sus errores y que Elena siempre fue su verdadera salvadora. Las mentiras de Aurora salen a la luz, el imperio Muñoz se derrumba, y Elena encuentra el amor y la confianza en Luciano. Su boda apasionada es sacudida por un atentado relacionado con el mundo criminal. Entre intrigas y traiciones, Elena emerge firme y decidida a vivir en libertad.

title: Pétalos de rosa y resurrección
description: El heredero de la familia más rica llevaba tres años en coma. Los mejores médicos fracasaron. Entonces llegó ella: una mendiga. Hubo risas, burlas y espadas desenvainadas. Ella no se inmutó. Un movimiento. Un roce. Silencio total. «Preparen un baño. Agua caliente y pétalos de rosa en cada rincón. ¿Y ese chico lindo?», dijo señalando al heredero. «Tráiganmelo».

title: Camarón: The Film

title: Balas y Diamantes
description: "Balas y Diamantes" cuenta la historia de una joven asiática secuestrada en su país de origen cuando era casi una niña y vendida junto a otras muchachas a un traficante en México quien no sólo las prostituyó, pero además, entrenó a algunas para que robaran para él. La joven logra fugarse con un botín de diamantes y escapar de México con la ayuda de un antiguo amante.

title: Entre Cunas y Mentiras
description: El mismo día dos mejores amigas dan a luz. Pero Astrid, que nació en la pobreza, cambia en secreto a su bebé por la de su amiga CEO, con la esperanza de darle a su hija una vida de lujo. Lo que no espera es que la CEO lo vea todo y cambie discretamente a las bebés de nuevo. 18 años más tarde, justo cuando el plan de Astrid está a punto de tener éxito, descubre la impactante verdad: la hija a la que ha maltratado todos estos años, es suya.

title: Mamá y Sus Tres Cupidos
description: Seis años después, Tiana regresa con tres hijos y un anillo de diamantes dejado por un misterioso hombre. Al buscar a su padre, los niños pierden el anillo.

title: ¿Cortar Lazos, Prosperar y Llorar?
description: Obrera Qi Lanzhi malcrió a su hijo Qin Yu tras perder a su hija. Él derrocha dinero pero la desprecia. Al intentar abandonarla, descubre que la CEO que atropelló a su madre es su hermana perdida. Juntas reforman a este "hijo inútil

title: El Director y el Fantasma
description:
El Director y el fantasma

Es una historia basada en la vida de un director de cine Hugo al cual su vida cambio repentinamente con la violenta muerta de su hija Lucy y la traición de su esposa Lina. Envuelto en la desesperación , la soledad y depresion se refugia en una casa antigua que pertenecia a sus padres. Apoyado únicamente por su mejor amigo y productor de sus películas Alan, Hugo busca ayuda en la iglesia donde el Padre Isaac lo trata de ayudar espiritualmente y buscando una ayuda psicológica lo recomienda al Dr. Ivan Luna.

Dentro de la soledad, frustacion, impotencia y depresión crea una realidad paralela a su realidad actual. Por la influencia del Dr. Luna, Hugo cambia completamente su vida y la de los demás, donde les hara sentir que a la miseria no le gusta estar sola.

title: Miércoles, Muros, Celdas y Puertas Entreabiertas
When His Loyalty Hit Zero
description: Mia can see a loyalty score floating above every head. Her childhood sweetheart Jack was a perfect hundred for six years—until jealousy slid in and the number started falling. When he tilts toward the girl he calls his sunshine, Mia doesn't cry or beg. She walks. Picking up running for herself, she's drawn to quiet Ethan, whose hundred never wavered since the day she pulled him into a P.E. group years ago. Jack sinks as he begs, tailgates, and schemes to win her back, but Mia won't chase empties anymore. She chose the one whose number never dropped.

title: WHO AM I? (The Documentary)
description: One question seeker's have asked for eternity, it has been humanity's deepest inquiry, it is a quest "Who am i?" and what your own unique answer is to that is what this film is aiming to stir open for everyone including the questioner, the speaker, and the viewer in an immersive and experiential manner. Documentary = truth telling, this film is doing exactly that, and it's letting the truth be experienced not just being told. Unless anything is experienced it is never fully accepted. Over 100 people from varied walks of life, age, professions, parts of the world, and strata of society all answer this one question who am i? There is no right or wrong or judgment but a clear witnessing of our human journey both as individuals and as a collective. The one question that really steers the direction of this film is - can this primary question that is being asked in the film really be answered and is there any cookie cutter formula where there can be 1 correct and definitive answer given and then one could either self-validate or begin to strive towards it as humans, we are conditioned to seek this easy way out, so is there one for this question too?

title: An Innocent Adventuress
description: Lindy, an innocent girl reared in a small town, accepts a letter for her friend Mrs. Bates from wealthy landlady Mrs. Cribbley. Believing the letter to be an eviction notice, Lindy postpones delivery, but soon becomes terrified upon learning that mail theft is a felony, and that her dog has destroyed the letter. Lindy's greatest admirer is reformed thief Dick Ross, who is now Mrs. Cribbley's secretary. His former partner-in-crime, "Doc" Brogan, robs Mrs. Cribbley's house, but she suspects a tramp called Chilowee Bill. Lindy erroneously thinks that her theft has been discovered, and when she befriends Chilowee Bill, Dick mistakenly assumes that she is in league with the robbers. He loses his incentive to reform and joins forces with Doc and Lindy. Although Dick plans to rob Mr. Meekton, Chilowee Bill does it first, leading Doc to suspect that he has been double-crossed. Bill confesses to protect Lindy, while Dick knocks Doc unconscious and retrieves Mrs. Cribbley's jewels. When Lindy confesses her fears, Dick reassembles the letter to show that it was only a request to return the garden hose.

title: No More Lies, No More Tears (DUBBED)
description: On the eve of a prestigious drawing contest, Kelvin Pace suffers severe injuries in an accident and is unable to pursue his dreams any further. While his caring sister explodes with rage and his loving fiancée is overwhelmed with heartbreak on the surface, they are secretly the culprits behind the incident—so that their adoptive brother, Luther Statham, can win instead. Upon learning the truth, Kelvin sinks into endless despair.

title: [Doublé] Divorcés mais pas séparés

Thomas fait alors irruption dans sa vie, plus insistant que jamais. Divorcés officiellement, ils ne peuvent pourtant pas se séparer.

description: Aarzu-e-Mann is a love story set in scenic San Francisco, about a Pakistani-American girl, Samira, who is born in a wealthy and politically connected Shah family. title: F#@K I Love U
description: F#@k I Love U is a dramatic tale of a modern family that gets quickly pulled into a spiral of interconnected events that test the limits of their bond and mutual love. Douglas Winston is, by all appearances, the perfect family man. A well groomed and successful black politician, he, his wife white Angie, and their two sons, James and Michael, seem to lead idyllic lives that quickly begin to unravel when Douglas visits his brother J, an white irresponsible would be actor with heavy drug and sex habits. After a jeopardizing incident endangers all of their lives, Douglas is quick to blame J and his irresponsible nature, but in trying to delve into the actual truth, the strands that hold his life together quickly start to unravel into a downward spiral of twisted connections, tangled love, and intrigue that will put to the test the true limits of his faith in those he loves and who he believes in.

Isa-isang inilatag ng mga kandidata ang mga paandar nilang intro, drawing laughter from the Madlang People in the studio. Si Vice Ganda, may napansin sa tatlong kandidata. Kung si Pia ay may mga matang ala Meryll Soriano, si Mama Dhel naman daw ay mukhang 'baby' na 36 years overdue.

Nang magsimula ang unang round, ang nasabi na lang ni Meme ay, "Diyos ko!" dahil sa sagot ng mga kandidata for today's video. Sa tanong na, "Ano ang plural ng salitang furniture?" sumagot ang isang kandidata, na para bang sure na sure, "Super furnitures."

Kaya si Meme, 'nanginig' at nag-react nang pabiro, "Nananawagan talaga kami sa Department of Education. Gumalaw na tayo."

Sina Mama Dhel at Samaya Jhay ang nagharap sa ikalawang round, Wit Lang. Ang pinusuan ng mga hurado ay si Mama Dhel bilang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra sa araw na 'to.

Pumuti man ang kanilang buhok, nananatili namang makulay ang sense of humor ng mga beloved lolo't lola from Meycauayan, Bulacan na nakisaya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Mga 'veterans' as in veterans sa pagpapatawa naman ang nagsama-sama sa You Gotta Lyric round na bagong inaabangan ng "It's Showtime" fans. Madlang People ay napa-wow nang si Vice Ganda ay lumabas bilang MemeRimar! Aww!

Ang happy ending sa kuwentong 'to ay para kay Tatay Philip, na umabante sa dulo ng laro. Positive lang ang pananaw ni tatay sa buhay. Aniya, pumunta siya sa "It's Showtime" nang walang dala, kaya aalis siyang sapat na ang P30,000 na Li-Pot offer.

title: Pus$y Catz
description: Pus$y Catz follows Lena, Toya, and Semone-three young women navigating survival, ambition, and temptation in the unforgiving streets of Atlanta. When a plan to secure fast money goes wrong, friendships fracture, secrets surface, and dangerous men close in from every direction. As betrayal brews within their own circle, each woman is forced to choose between loyalty, love, and the desperate fight to protect her future. What begins as hustle turns into a high-stakes war of trust, power, and consequences. As the women push deeper into a high-stakes hustle that promises fast cash, their world quickly becomes a maze of scams gone wrong, toxic relationships, manipulation, and revenge. A shady figure from Lena's past reappears, Toya's choices draw unwanted attention, and Semone's loyalty is tested on all sides. The trio begins to fracture, with each woman caught in the crossfire of decisions they can't take back. The tension reaches a breaking point when a setup turns violent, exposing hidden alliances, buried grudges, and a truth that threatens to destroy their bond forever. In a final confrontation where reputations, relationships, and lives hang in the balance, the women must decide: Will they claw their way out together, or tear each other apart? Pus$y Catz Bratz is a gritty, stylish blend of urban drama, betrayal thriller, and character-driven storytelling-where every choice has a cost, and every secret has claws.

title: Al-Khimyah
description: Al-Khimyah explores the work of the Aga Khan Trust for Culture (AKTC) in the historic city of Cairo, Egypt. The film shines a spotlight on the 30-hectare Al-Azhar Park - converted from a mound of rubble - and the stories of local residents of the adjacent al-Darb al-Ahmar neighbourhood. The park has also proven to be a powerful catalyst for urban renewal, evolving beyond the green space itself to include the restoration of monuments and public spaces, and socioeconomic initiatives including housing rehabilitation, microfinance, crafts apprenticeships, and healthcare. Since opening in 2005 after 20 years of careful excavation and design, Al-Azhar Park has provided much-needed leisure and recreational space to the inhabitants of the city, and is today often referred to as "Cairo's green lung."

title: Destinada ao meu acompanhante bilionário
description: Diane promete à avó no leito de morte que terá um bebê, mas logo descobre a traição do marido, Miles. Devastada, ela termina o casamento de sete anos. Incentivada pela amiga Maggie, Diane passa uma noite louca com um lindo garoto de programa chamado Eddie. Porém, sua cegueira noturna esconde uma verdade chocante: Eddie é Dominic, ex-colega de faculdade que a ama em segredo há anos. Agora um bilionário implacável, ele fará de tudo para tê-la de volta. De dia, é um magnata poderoso; à noite, atua como seu garoto de programa dedicado para fazê-la se apaixonar.

title: O Último Adeus ao Ente Querido
description: Annie nunca conheceu o amor de sua mãe. Carole a desprezava, reservando todo o seu carinho e afeto para Fiona, a filha de um romance do passado. Carole acreditava que seu casamento com Ben foi um erro de bêbado, e Annie era simplesmente o resultado lamentável. Incapaz de suportar o abuso que Annie sofria, Ben resolveu levar Annie e deixar Carole para sempre. Apesar disso, em seu próprio aniversário, Annie decidiu dar à sua mãe uma última chance.

title: Tonight at Noon
description: Lee (Chiwetel Ejiofor) and Mae (Lauren Ambrose) are a couple trying to work out their differences. As Mae struggles with memories of a former flame, Lee, who is a writer, works through his frustration by forming his problems into a story in his mind. And that's when everything starts shifting back and forth from reality to Lee's imagination.

title: Orson at the Orient
description: Orson at the Orient is the story of a meeting no one admits happened: A bombed city under martial law and powers on the verge of a new war give home to deceit and uncertainty in 1948 Vienna. The city, divided among the allied powers, is also hosting the filming of The Third Man. It's star, American actor Orson Welles is spending his after-hours in the well-known Hotel Orient, soon to be disturbed by Soviet troops led by a young Officer. On his mind only one mission. How can he use the strengths and weaknesses of the great Orson to change the course of history, while in the U.S. big Hollywood names are targeted in the Red Scare initiating the McCarthy era.

title: Talking Back at Thunder
description: Jacob's life is uprooted by the reappearance of a childhood demon. After attempting in vain to wrest his anguish, he forces himself upon his enemy. A battle of justice, morality, and life ensues for both Jacob and his foe.

title: Au pays des colons
description: In the 1930s, in the throes of the Great Depression, the government of Quebec relocated more than 80,000 citizens to found a new settlement in the virgin forests of Quebec's Abitibi region. After enduring backbreaking work to clear the land, however, many left, seeking a better life in the city or as labourers for the large corporations that had come to exploit the North's valuable resources. The Lalancette family, however, have persisted in forging their future on the land from one generation to the next, earning their keep from farming, and defying the constraints of globalization and the mining and forestry companies that control the area. Revisiting the heritage of Quebec filmmakers who documented Abitibi, following in the footsteps of Pierre Perrault, among others, this documentary traces a defining chapter of Quebec history and raises fundamental questions about regional development.

title: Poly au Portugal
description: Pascal is spending a holiday in Portugal with two other French children called Richard and Mariane. Humiliated, beaten, and extorted by local officials, Liam hides his identity and sets a trap to expose every corrupt figure at his homecoming banquet.

title: Being Fired? Now I'm Out of Their League!
description: Forced into an engagement, Julian follows his grandpa's order, works at Harper Enterprise, secretly making Serena the new Wall Street business queen. But Serena and her assistant Damian drive him out, and the company collapses without him.

title: Deet N Bax Save Th' World
description: Bloody Stoner Odyssey full of Sex, Guns'n Weed.

title: Song-o
description: A group of city dwellers make a trip of three days and two nights into the isolated countryside to visit a friend in the hills. Their true nature begins to reveal itself: love hidden but never forgotten, primitive desires suppressed in the city, nasty pride that triumphs only over the weak and a strong will for survival that sacrifices even love and friendship.

title: O Novo CEO é o Meu Ginecologista (Dublado)
description: Clara vive presa em um casamento sem intimidade e desenvolve hipersexualidade. Em busca de ajuda, ela é humilhada pelo Dr. Killian durante um exame, pouco antes de descobrir a traição do marido. A reviravolta acontece quando o novo CEO da empresa se revela ser o próprio Killian. Ele passa a se aproveitar da condição dela, forçando-a à submissão e levando o relacionamento dos dois ao limite.

title: Ballada o Januszku
description: A single mother, blinded by the love for her trouble-making son Januszek, makes more and more sacrifices for him.

title: Bhalobasa O Andhakar
description: Bhalobasa-O-Andhakar is a 1992 Indian Bengali film, directed by Dipranjan Bose and produced by Bhalobasa-O-Andhakar Roy. The film stars Sanchita Bose, Kushal Chakraborty and Satya Banerjee in lead roles. Music of the film was composed by Goutam Chatterjee.

title: O Governante Supremo
description: O protagonista, dotado de superpoderes, fica ainda mais forte após um período de cultivo. Ele derrota e elimina todos os vilões que antes o intimidavam. Para salvar sua mãe, ele enfrenta inúmeros perigos. No final, ao reunir a força de seu povo, ele supera a rebelião e se torna o líder supremo.

title: Shangoul o Mangoul
description: On a field trip a young schoolteacher named Mary [Afsaneh Bayegan] tells the story Shangoul and Mangoul to the children: The lion, as king of the jungle, sets up a contest between the wolf and the fox where he will hire the one who brings him delicious food the soonest. The wolf and the fox kidnap the baby goats (Shangoul, Mangoul and Grape). The wolf decides to eat Shangoul and Mangoul himself but the fox takes Grape to the lion. The mother goat goes looking for her children and she and other the animals of the forest restrain the wolf and the fox; the baby goats are returned to their mother safe and sound.

title: Entre Dois Alfas: O Passado vs. O Presente
description: Com dezoito anos, fui obrigada a escolher um dos filhos do Alfa como meu companheiro. Na vida passada, escolhi Cain — um grande erro. Ele me destruiu por completo. Desta vez, escolhi Casey, o de sangue frio, o mais brutal de todos. O que eu não esperava era que Cain também tivesse voltado.

title: Segunda Chance: O Caminho para o Bilhão(Dublado)
description: Na vida passada, Henrique usou os quatro milhões ganhos na loteria para fingir ser herdeiro e entrar na elite. Achou que conhecer poderosos mudaria seu destino, mas, dez anos depois, foi desmascarado e humilhado em público. Ao despertar, descobre que renasceu e voltou ao verão do último ano escolar. Com os quatro milhões, lucra com oportunidades na madeira, nos futuros de borracha e no petróleo. Desta vez, não vai fingir ser rico: vai construir a própria fortuna do zero!

title: Enchi o Banco do Além até o Limite
description:
Com a chegada do Submundo, Daniel Soares, que morreu nesse mundo em sua vida passada, renasce antes do evento com uma interface de jogo. Usando dinheiro ritual, ele abastece completamente sua conta no Submundo, adquirindo riqueza ilimitada.

Quando o Submundo finalmente desce sobre o mundo, Daniel usa sua fortuna infinita para forjar três artefatos divinos, evolui sua classe de ferreiro de nível D para Ferreiro Divino e, após três evoluções, ascende ao posto de Deus Criador. No fim, ele derrota o chefe final do mundo do Submundo.

title: Demon Lord, Retry!
description: On the night of his favorite game's shutdown, Akira Oono awakens in the body of his online character: Demon Lord Hakuto Kunai.

title: An American Widow
description: Wealthy American widow Elizabeth Carter plans to marry the Earl of Dettminster when lawyer Augustus Tucker informs her of a codicil in her late husband's will. The Carter fortune will go to nephew Pitney Carter, who is in love with Elizabeth, if her second husband is not an American. Elizabeth therefore pays penniless playwright Jasper Mallory $50,000 to marry her and schemes with actress Mme. Albani to provide grounds for divorce so that she may then make the earl her third husband. The plan backfires when Jasper's play is a success and Elizabeth finds herself falling in love with him. title: Promesse à mon frère d'armes tombé au combat
description: Ares est un héros de guerre décoré des forces spéciales qui prend sa retraite après la mort au combat de son plus proche camarade. Hanté par le traumatisme, il est lié par une promesse : protéger la femme et la fille de son frère d'armes tombé au combat. Victimes d'une arnaque financière, elles se retrouvent criblées de dettes et terrorisées par des voyous locaux. Ares intervient avec une efficacité redoutable, avant de découvrir que ces hommes ne sont que du menu fretin. Derrière eux se cache un vaste réseau criminel composé de flics corrompus, de responsables véreux et de taupes militaires. Ils salissent sa réputation, lui tendent des pièges et tentent de le détruire. Mais il ne cède pas. Il réunit ses fidèles camarades, se bat sans relâche, démantèle le syndicat, éradique la corruption et blanchit son nom. Finalement, il tient sa promesse, venge les innocents et fait chuter tout ce système pourri, prouvant que le serment d'un seul homme peut renverser un empire bâti sur des mensonges.

title: Bhikhari Boss
description:
A billionaire hiding as a beggar to escape an arranged marriage. An orphan girl abandoned at the altar on her wedding day. Two strangers with nothing — and everything to lose.
When fate throws them together at the worst moment of both their lives, the most unlikely deal is struck.
This is a story of two broken people who accidentally become each other's biggest plot twist.

title: Golden Boy Ki Love Story
description: Yohan, a hidden billionaire, marries Suhana, who is forced to wed to save her inheritance. As love grows, he reveals his true identity and protects her from betrayal and danger. In the end, they overcome all odds and find happiness together.

title: Fake Doctor
description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

title: King's Killer Comeback

Shaadi ka setup ego clashes aur hidden truths ka battlefield ban jaata hai, jahan har episode ke saath tension aur stakes badhte hain. yeh story greed, ambition aur ultimate power reveal ko explore karti hai

title: Dream
description: Years ago, journalist Shen Yueshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now, she returns to Lacheng, picking up her camera again to explore those corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian were once the protagonists of her lens, yet their fates have been shaped by the passage of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time, and Shen Yueshui travels between the past and the present, uncovering these long-forgotten tales.

title: Crash Course Geology
description:
In 25 episodes, we’re going to learn about geology—the study of Earth’s physical structure and processes. Our host, Sage, will teach you about the geological forces and cycles that shape our planet’s past, present, and future. 

This content is based on an introductory university-level curriculum. By the end of this course, you should be able to: 

Trace Earth’s development from its earliest periods to its current structure
Understand the forces of plate tectonics and how they shape Earth’s landscape
Describe the formation of geologic elements like minerals, rocks, and gems 
Identify geologic forces and cycles that impact the earth, while dispelling myths about extreme geological hazards
Learn what geology reveals about Earth’s distant past and what it can teach us about our current changing climate
Explore the geology of other planets within the context of Earth’s unique and common qualities and phenomena
Become familiar with different specialities within geology and what different types of geologists do

Key texts cited include:
Marshak, Stephen. 2021. Earth: Portrait of a Planet, Seventh Edition.
Babcock, Loren E. 2009. Gemstones and Precious Metals.

title: Speak English Professionally: In Person, Online & On the Phone
description:
Do you want to speak better English? This course will help you reach that goal. Speak English Professionally: In person, Online and On the Phone will boost your English speaking skills. In this 5 week course, you will learn how to identify and make a strong personal introduction. You will develop and demonstrate the speaking skills for group discussions: how to agree or disagree, how to clarify, restate and summarize. You will review and practice how to give information and respond to requests on the phone. You will study and role play effective interviewing. You will prepare and give a sales “pitch”, introducing a product or service. Throughout the course, you will adjust how you speak English and you will become more fluent and accurate when you speak. You will demonstrate culturally appropriate body language and tone. As you work through the course, you will complete self- and peer-evaluations. Through a combination of lectures, comprehension and vocabulary quizzes, practice and performance, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to communicate well in English, anywhere in the world.	
By the end of this course you will:
• Change how you speak English
•	Improve your pronunciation and fluency 
• Increase your English vocabulary 
•	Identify how culture influences your speech
•	Use culture to help you speak correctly 
•	Demonstrate the best body language for different cultural settings
•	Know statements, questions and responses for different settings and situations

title: Introduction to HTML, CSS, & JavaScript
description:
Want to take the first steps to become a Web Developer? This course will help you discover the languages, frameworks, and tools you will need to create interactive and engaging websites right from the beginning. 
You’ll begin by understanding the roles of front-end, back-end, and full-stack developers and how they collaborate, along with the terminology and skills essential for a web development career. 
Next, you’ll dive deep into HTML5—learning about structural elements like section, article, header, footer, and form controls such as input, fieldset, and legend. You’ll also explore the Document Object Model (DOM), scripting basics, and browser compatibility. 
Moving on to CSS, you’ll learn how to style and format web pages using selectors, IDs, and classes. You’ll explore layout tools like Flexbox and gain hands-on experience with responsive design using frameworks such as Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap. In JavaScript, you'll learn about variables, control structures, functions, prototypes, and how to interact with the DOM, along with practical experience using APIs and client-side scripting techniques to enhance user interaction. 
By learning the fundamentals of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, you will be able to combine them to: 
 - Create the basic structure of a website 
 - Create format and layout for web applications 
 - Enhance your website and create rich, interactive applications 
 - Increase user interactivity and enhance user experience 
 - Give your website a real wow factor! 
Throughout the course, you'll apply your learning through numerous hands-on labs and conclude with a final project where you'll build a webpage to showcase your skills and strengthen your portfolio.

title: C for Everyone, Part 1: Programming Fundamentals
description:
This course is for everyone. In the new world we live in, coding is a universally valuable skill, whether you're a scientist, artist, or a humanist. Algorithms are everywhere, and we all have to understand how they work. The C language is particularly well suited as an introduction to coding: It's a tried-and-true language, and it allows you to understand computing processes at a deep level. 
This course is the first part of a two-course sequence. It is a hands-on introduction to programming in C, designed to guide learners step by step from the basics of syntax and data types to more advanced concepts such as control flow, functions, recursion, arrays, and pointers. Through video lessons, quizzes, programming exercises, and real debugging tasks, learners build foundational concepts and good coding practices. By the end, learners will be able to write clear C programs, debug effectively, and build the knowledge base needed for more advanced computer science and software development.

title: Scratch in Hindi
description:
आज की दुनिया में कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग की समझ एक महत्वपूर्ण कौशल बन गयी है. कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग, जिसको कोडिंग भी कहते हैं, नियोजनीयता बढ़ाने में भी साकारत्मक भूमिका निभाती है। कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग करने से logical thinking भी विकसित होती है. 

कुछ वर्षों पहले, अमेरिका की MIT यूनिवर्सिटी के MIT Media Lab ने बच्चों में कोडिंग की रूचि जागृत करने के लिए Scratch नाम की एक फ्री सॉफ्टवेयर बनाई थी. Scratch अब बहुत प्रचलित हो गयी है और करोड़ों बच्चे, अध्यापक और अभिभावक आज Scratch के users हैं. 

Scratch में बहुत सरल block-based programming के ज़रिये आप मस्त games, animation और interactive stories इत्यादि बना सकते हैं. Scratch के नए version 3.0 में कई नए advanced features भी हैं जैसे Artificial Intelligence. 

इस वीडियो श्रृंखला में आप सीखेंगे free software Scratch में प्रोग्रामिंग.
